rows.wylie: gnyis pa ni de lta bu'i gang zag des rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs dang phyi nang gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma ngo sprod pa'i phyir 'di'i sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob cing chag med du nyams su len par 'dod pa'o
rows.english: We turn now to the kind of person who is fit to practice the path which liberates us.  Our position is that this kind of person is one first of all who has received an authentic form of the blessing of the Angel in Her sindhura secret world, something which is done for the purpose of introducing the disciple to the fact that their own actions, words, and thoughts actually are the enlightened body, speech, and mind of the Angel of Diamond; and for the purpose too of having them meet, for the first time, the Angel in Her outer, inner, and secret forms.  Secondly, the person must be maintaining an uninterrupted practice of this Angel. The Teaching to Be Practiced

rows.acip: GNYIS PA GANG NYAMS SU BLANG BA'I CHOS NI, RNAL 'BYOR GSANG MTHA'I RGYUD KYI BCUD PHYUNG BA BOD LJONGS BSTAN PA'I MNGA' BDAG DPAL LDAN SA SKYA'I LCAGS RI MI 'DA' BA'I GSER CHOS BCU GSUM KYI NANG TSAN MCHOG BSGRUBS PAS THUN MONG ZHAR LA 'GRUB PA DMAR MO SKOR GSUM DU GRAGS PA'I SNYING PO'AM MCHOG TU GYUR PA,
rows.wylie: gnyis pa gang nyams su blang ba'i chos ni, rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi bcud phyung ba bod ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan sa skya'i lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum kyi nang tshan mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar la 'grub pa dmar mo skor gsum du grags pa'i snying po'am mchog tu gyur pa
rows.english: Here secondly is our explanation of the teaching it is which we put into practice.  The teaching we present here is the very heart, the very pinnacle, of the instructions known as the Three Collections of the Crimson Queen.  These themselves form an integral part of the Thirteen Teachings of Gold, and are a method of attaining the ultimate goal and thereby automatically reaching all the shared goals of the world as well. The Thirteen Teachings were never to be allowed beyond the walls of Sakya Monastery, and were the purview of the glorious tradition of the Sakyas, who are themselves the absolute lords of the Word of the Buddha here in the Land of Snows.  The Thirteen Teachings are the distilled essence of all the tantras of the yoga of the ultimate secret.

rows.english: And what exactly is the teaching we present here?  It is the advices on the Heaven of Naropa: instructions which enable us to travel to the Heaven of the Sky in this life, before we die.  These advices were granted directly to the accomplished saint Narotapa by the Angel of Daimond. These are instructions possess the four qualities of an authentic oral tradition.  That is, they possess an authentic Lama, an authentic Word, an authentic commentarial tradition, and authentic experience.

rows.acip: DANG PO NI, RGYAL BA RDO RJE 'CHANG GIS GSUNGS PA RNAMS LA 'KHRUL PA'I DRI MA DANG BRAL BA GDUL BYA LA 'DOMS MKHAS PA, GNYIS PA NI RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA 'DI BDE MCHOG RTZA RGYUD NAS GSUNGS PA DANG, GSUM PA NI N'A RO PA'I GZHUNG CHUNG SOGS TSAD MA RNAMS DANG, BZHI PA NI 'DI NAS BSHAD PA'I NYAMS MYONG RGYUD LA SKYES PA STE MOS BLO TZAM MA YIN PAR GO BA PHUL PHYIN RNYED PA BZHI DANG LDAN PA'O,,
rows.wylie: dang po ni, rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa rnams la 'khrul pa'i dri ma dang bral ba gdul bya la 'doms mkhas pa, gnyis pa ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di bde mchog rtsa rgyud nas gsungs pa dang, gsum pa ni nA ro pa'i gzhung chung sogs tshad ma rnams dang, bzhi pa ni 'di nas bshad pa'i nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa ste mos blo tsam ma yin par go ba phul phyin rnyed pa bzhi dang ldan pa'o
rows.english: What is an authentic Lama here?  It is one who is able to impart to their disciple, without the slightest taint of error, the teachings spoken by the victorious Buddha, the Keeper of the Diamond. What makes these teachings the authentic Word?  The fact that this practice of the Angel of Diamond was spoken in the root tantra of Highest Bliss. What is the authentic commentarial tradition here?  Authentic commentaries such as the Short Classics of Naropa. And where is there authentic experience?  It is here because there are those who have actually reached a consummate grasp of these instructions, a grasp which is far beyond mere aspiring: who have actually been able to trigger within themselves the spiritual experiences described here.

rows.english: Now you'd be a laughing stock if the big race was to be held on one racetrack and you spent all your time beforehand getting your horse familiar with a different racetrack.  And so we're missing the point if we get good at one topic by studying and contemplating upon it, and then when the time comes to actually undertake some spiritual practice we work on something else. This teaching for us then should not be left at the level of something we've learned about; rather, we must see how to actually carry out those same practices that we master in our classes, and work out intellectually.

rows.english: As for the first practice, that of sleeping, there is a tradition of the Sakyas that began with their founding fathers, the Five Great Sakyas, and which has been repeated by most authors of treatises on this subject since then.  This tradition states that to carry out the various practices one must first awake; and to awake one must first sleep; and that this is why the practice of sleeping comes before the others.  This though is not the true intent of the secret teachings.

rows.english: As spoken here, night is the time when all the outer Angels are especially active, traveling around, meeting with one another.  If we start our practice off at this particular time, when all the Angels of the twenty-four sacred places are making their rounds far and wide, then They will take us into their care; They will bless our being; our realizations will come quickly, and we will reach our goal of the Heaven of the Angel with speed.  The timing of this practice therefore helps us get off to a good start towards these and our other goals; it is of vital significance.

rows.english: No matter which of the two ways you use to waken, get up and make a fierce resolution that will carry through the day: Be it my whole life in general, or this year which is part of it, or this month which is part of that, or most especially this day which is part of it, I will not waste this precious time.  I will take perfect advantage of the life of leisure and fortune that I have now: I will carry out the practices of this my Holy Lama Angel's path; both the creation stage, and the completion stage.

rows.english: With this, we have reached the third of the sections which describe how we put into actual practice the instructions on both the stage of creation and the stage of completion for this Angel.  This section is the one which describes how we actually undertake the practice, and it has eleven different parts. The first of these describes the yoga which is referred to in the summary with the words "Sleeping..."  There are two different methods of performing this yoga.  One follows the stage of creation, and involves conceptual elaborations.  The second follows the stage of completion, and is free of such elaborations. Yoga One: The Practice of Sleeping

rows.acip: DE NAS LUS GNAD DANG LDAN PAR 'KHOD NAS, MDUN GYI NAM MKHAR SOGS TSAR GCIG BRJOD, BLA MAS SKYABS DNGOS SU STON PA, SANGS RGYAS KYIS BRGYUD NAS STON PA, CHOS SKYABS DNGOS TE, DE NYID RANG GIS NYAMS SU BLANGS PAS SKYOB NUS SHING, DGE 'DUN RNAMS KYIS JI LTAR LAM LA SLOB PA LTAR BDAG GIS KYANG SLOB SNYAM PA'I GROGS ZHUS,
rows.wylie: de nas lus gnad dang ldan par 'khod nas, mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs tshar gcig brjod, bla mas skyabs dngos su ston pa, sangs rgyas kyis brgyud nas ston pa, chos skyabs dngos te, de nyid rang gis nyams su blangs pas skyob nus shing, dge 'dun rnams kyis ji ltar lam la slob pa ltar bdag gis kyang slob snyam pa'i grogs zhus
rows.english: Next you should assume the posture for meditation, and recite the line which begins with "In the air in front of me."  [The full line reads: "In the air in front of me are seated the Lama, the Union of Spheres, man and woman, surrounded by an assembly of my root and lineage Lamas, Close Angels and the Three Supreme, the Protectors of the Word."] Our Lama directly teaches us how to find protection; the Buddha teaches us this same thing indirectly.  The real shelter though is the Dharma, because it is the one thing which--if we actually put it into practice--is able to protect us.  The Community of those who are realized provide us with assistance: we think to ourselves, "I will train myself in the path, just as they have already managed to do."

rows.english: It is necessary for us to distinguish this practice from others with those attitudes that are unique to Buddhism: going for refuge, developing the Wish, and correct view. rows.english: And to become a Buddha, I will now practice the path of the Holy Angel of Diamond. Think this way to yourself, which is the ultimate form of personal responsibility. rows.acip: RDZOGS PA'I BYANG CHUB KYI BDE BA LA 'GOD PAR BYA ZHES BAS BDE BA DANG LDAN 'DOD KYI BYAMS PA TSAD MED, SEMS CAN THAMS CAD SANGS RGYAS KYI GO 'PHANG THOB NA RANG GI 'DOD DON MTHAR THUG GRUB PAS DGA' BA TSAD MED YIN, TSAD MED BZHI BSGOM PA SPYI LTAR BTON KYANG CHOG ,
rows.wylie: rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba la 'god par bya zhes bas bde ba dang ldan 'dod kyi byams pa tshad med, sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na rang gi 'dod don mthar thug grub pas dga' ba tshad med yin, tshad med bzhi bsgom pa spyi ltar bton kyang chog
rows.english: The words "lead them finally to the bliss of total enlightenment" stand for the limitless prayer of love, the kind of love that wants beings to get every kind of happiness.  If every living being actually did reach the state of Buddhahood, then our own ultimate hope would be achieved, and this is the limitless prayer of joy.  It's also all right at this point if you do your meditation on these four attitudes by reciting the limitless prayers the way we usually do them in our other rituals.

rows.english: The Four Immeasurables are the cause, and the Wish for enlightenment is the result; it's as we find it in the seven advices of cause and result. Nonetheless, we can say that the words "I swear I will reach the state of a fully enlightened Buddha" express immeasurable compassion, whereas the words "lead them finally to the bliss of total enlightenment" express immeasurable love.

rows.english: The happiness that comes when each and every living being reaches the state of total enlightenment is not like the happiness that we find here in the cycle of pain, for this higher happiness will never go away.  And wishing then that beings could stay in this state is immeasurable joy.

rows.acip: DE'I YANG SNYING RJE BTZUN N'A RO MKHA' SPYOD MA 'DI BYIN RLABS SHIN TU MYUR BAR MA ZAD DBANG PO ZHAN PA RNAMS LA CHES SHIN TU NYAMS SU LEN BDE ZHING 'JUG PA BDE BA'I PHYIR RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MA'I LAM GYI RIM PA NYAMS SU LEN SNYAM PA'I 'DUN PA DRAG PO YANG BYA'O,
rows.wylie: de'i yang snying rje btsun nA ro mkha' spyod ma 'di byin rlabs shin tu myur bar ma zad dbang po zhan pa rnams la ches shin tu nyams su len bde zhing 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lam gyi rim pa nyams su len snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po yang bya'o
rows.english: And the very essence of this Wheel--the practice of the Lady of the Heaven of Holy Naropa--is infinitely quick.  Not only that, but it is also extraordinarily easy for those of feeble spiritual powers to put into actual practice, and to start off into in the first place.  As such, you must bring up within yourself fierce feelings, a fierce desire to carry out each step to the path of the Angel of Diamond.

rows.acip: DPAL LDAN ZLA BAS, KUN RDZOB DE NYID GSHOG YANGS DKAR PO RGYAS GYUR PA, SOGS NAS, RGYAL BA'I YON TAN RGYA MTSO'I PHA ROL MCHOG TU 'GRO, ZHES GSUNGS PA'I KUN RDZOB NI THABS BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS DANG, DE NYID CES PA SHES RAB STONG PA NYID DE, SNGAGS KYI NYAMS LEN KYANG THABS SHES 'DI GNYIS YA MA BRAL BA'I NGANG NAS BYED PA DGOS,
rows.wylie: dpal ldan zla bas, kun rdzob de nyid gshog yangs dkar po rgyas gyur pa, sogs nas, rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol mchog tu 'gro, zhes gsungs pa'i kun rdzob ni thabs byang chub kyi sems dang, de nyid ces pa shes rab stong pa nyid de, sngags kyi nyams len kyang thabs shes 'di gnyis ya ma bral ba'i ngang nas byed pa dgos
rows.english: And finally, the glorious Chandrakirti has spoken the lines that begin with "On vast wide-spreading wings of both the conventional and the real" and go up to "Reaching to the farthest shore of the ocean of Victors' qualities."  The "conventional" that Master Chandrakirti refers to here is the method, the Wish for enlightenment.  The "real" that He speaks of is the wisdom, or emptiness.  All of these quotations are drawn from the open teachings; in the practice of the secret word as well you must act from a position where this method and this wisdom, the two of them, never come one without the other.

rows.acip: RJE NGAG DBANG BYAMS PAS DBANG CHEN SKABS KYANG LAM RIM MANG DU GSUNGS PAR LCANG SKYA ROL RDOR GYIS SNGAGS KYI ZAB MYUR GYI KHYAD LAM RIM GYIS 'DON DGOS PAS DE SHIN TU GNAD CHE ZHES BSNGAGS BRJOD MDZAD PA LTAR LAM RIM NAS GSUNGS PA'I LTA BA DANG BYANG SEMS LA NAN TAN DGOS,
rows.wylie: rje ngag dbang byams pas dbang chen skabs kyang lam rim mang du gsungs par lcang skya rol rdor gyis sngags kyi zab myur gyi khyad lam rim gyis 'don dgos pas de shin tu gnad che zhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa ltar lam rim nas gsungs pa'i lta ba dang byang sems la nan tan dgos
rows.english: The Lord, Ngawang Jampa, used to teach a lot from the texts on the path to enlightenment whenever He granted a great initiation.  Changkya Rolpay Dorje praised Him for this, saying, "This has great significance, for the special features of the secret word, its deepness and its quickness, must be brought out with the steps to the path."  And so it is: you must then make persistent efforts at gaining this view and the Wish, as they are presented in the steps to the path.

rows.acip: DBEN SA PAS, ,MDOR NA NYAMS RTOGS CHE CHUNG GANG SKYES KYANG, ,DAD PA CHE CHUNG BSGOMS PA'I MTHU YIN PAS, ,DNGOS GRUB RTZA BA DRIN CAN BLA MA YI, ,YON TAN BSAM ZHING SKYON NAS MI BLTA BA'I, ,GDAMS PA 'DI NYID MTHIL DU 'DZIN PAR SHOG ,DAM BCA' 'DI 'DRA GEGS MED MTHAR PHYIN SHOG CES GSUNGS,
rows.wylie: dben sa pas, ,mdor na nyams rtogs che chung gang skyes kyang, ,dad pa che chung bsgoms pa'i mthu yin pas, ,dngos grub rtsa ba drin can bla ma yi, ,yon tan bsam zhing skyon nas mi blta ba'i, ,gdams pa 'di nyid mthil du 'dzin par shog ,dam bca' 'di 'dra gegs med mthar phyin shog ces gsungs
rows.english: Master Wensapa described it as follows: In short, whether we develop greater or lesser Spiritual practice and realizations Depends on the force with which we meditate On faith that itself is greater or lesser. Think therefore on the good qualities Of your Lama of kindness, the root Of all attainments, and do not look For faults in Them. May I keep this one advice The center of my practice; May I bring this resolve Unhindered to its final end. [Translator's note: The Tibetan editor notes that the Tibetan for the next to the last line is not precisely the original form, which we find elsewhere as MTHIL DU 'DZIN PA DANG,.]

rows.acip: SKU MDOG DMAR POR BYED PA'ANG SLOB MA LA THUGS RJES SU CHAGS PA'I NYAMS CAN, RJES CHAGS NI, 'GRO LA CHAGS PAS KUN CHAGS MDZAD, ,CES PA LTAR SLOB MA LA THUGS BRTZE BA SNYING RJE CHEN POS DUS NAM DU'ANG BTANG MI BYA BA LTA BU'I RJES SU CHAGS PA STE DE LTAR RAM,
rows.wylie: sku mdog dmar por byed pa'ang slob ma la thugs rjes su chags pa'i nyams can, rjes chags ni, 'gro la chags pas kun chags mdzad, ,ces pa ltar slob ma la thugs brtse ba snying rje chen pos dus nam du'ang btang mi bya ba lta bu'i rjes su chags pa ste de ltar ram
rows.english: The reason we make His holy body red, by the way, is to give Him the look of loving attachment to His students.  When we say "attachment" here we mean it in the sense it has in the famous line, "He is wrapped in attachment for living beings."  This is describing a kind of attachment in which our Lama has such love and compassion for His or Her students that They are totally incapable of ever giving up on them.

rows.acip: 'DI LA LHA'I RNGA DBYANGS SU DNGUL CHU BAS DPA' BO RDO RJE CHOS SU GNANG BA'I DGONGS PA NGAG DBANG NYI ZLA BZANG PO DANG BYAMS PA CHOS LEGS GSUNG PA LTAR YAB YUM THUN MONG GI RTZA DBU MA CHE BA'I SKABS BLA MA SANGS RGYAS RDO RJE CHOS DANG, YUM GYI THUN MIN RTZA DBU MA CHUNG BA'I SKABS DPA' BO RDO RJE CHOS SU BSGOM DGOS PA'I DBANG DU MDZAD PA LAS, DE GNYIS LA SPANGS RTOGS MCHOG DMAN MED PAS 'DIR DPA' BO RDO RJE CHOS KYI RNAM PAR BSGOM NA LEGS PAR GSUNGS KYANG,
rows.wylie: 'di la lha'i rnga dbyangs su dngul chu bas dpa' bo rdo rje chos su gnang ba'i dgongs pa ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po dang byams pa chos legs gsung pa ltar yab yum thun mong gi rtsa dbu ma che ba'i skabs bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos dang, yum gyi thun min rtsa dbu ma chung ba'i skabs dpa' bo rdo rje chos su bsgom dgos pa'i dbang du mdzad pa las, de gnyis la spangs rtogs mchog dman med pas 'dir dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bsgom na legs par gsungs kyang
rows.english: In His work Drumsong of the Gods, [the son] Ngulchu Rinpoche describes the Lama here as having the form of Dharma of Diamond the Warrior.  What He had in mind when He wrote this is interpreted by Ngawang Nyinda Sangpo and Jampa Chulek as follows. For the greater practice of the central channel, which is common to both the Man and the Wife, we are supposed to meditate on our Lama as Dharma of Diamond the Buddha.  For the lesser practice of the central channel, which is unique to the Wife, we should meditate on Them as Dharma of Diamond the Warrior.  Ngulchu Rinpoche's description, these writers say, was meant to reflect this distinction.  It is not the case, they state, that either one of these beings is in any way superior or inferior to the other in what He has eliminated and what He has realized.  They conclude therefore that it is best to meditate on your Lama in the form of Dharma of Diamond the Warrior.

rows.acip: BLA MA SANGS RGYAS BYANG SEMS GZHAN LAS BKA' DRIN LHAG PAR CHE BAS NA TSUL BZHIN DU BSTEN NAS GDAMS NGAG RNAMS ZHU BA DANG NYAMS SU LEN PA DANG GSOL BA 'DEBS PA SOGS KYI RTEN 'BREL TSOGS PA LA BRTEN NAS TSOGS GNYIS BDE BLAG TU RDZOGS TE CHOS NYID RTOGS PAR 'GYUR BA'I CHED DU RGYAS BTAB BO,
rows.wylie: bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems gzhan las bka' drin lhag par che bas na tshul bzhin du bsten nas gdams ngag rnams zhu ba dang nyams su len pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa sogs kyi rten 'brel tshogs pa la brten nas tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs te chos nyid rtogs par 'gyur ba'i ched du rgyas btab bo
rows.english: Because your Lama's kindness for you is more than that of other Buddhas and bodhisattvas, you should take yourself to Them in the proper way, request Their personal advices, put these into practice in your life, beg Them for Their blessings, and so on.  If you are able to get off to a right start in this way, you will easily gather together the two collections.  And so that you come to realize the true nature of things, you should seal your practice in this way.

rows.wylie: bcad don nyams len sems 'dzin gyi bya ba la, gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gnyis gzhung zur du yod pa rnams gzhung bzhin la, gnyis bral zhes pa rtsa dbu ma'i ming yin la, rgya skad du aa wa dhU tI zhes 'byung, de bod skad du gnyis spangs zhes bya ste
rows.english: Now we will focus on some of the practical aspects of your practice, and the visualization.  There are separate texts which explain the two oral instructions of the practice that relate to what is "bereft of the two," and you should follow these works.  "Bereft of the two" is a word for the central channel.  It is what they call avadhuti in Sanskrit, which in Tibetan means "free of the two."

rows.acip: KU S'A LI'I TSOGS GSOG SKABS, KU S'A LI ZHES PA DGE BA CAN LA 'JUG PAS NANG GI YON TAN SBAS NAS MKHAS NYAMS GRUB NYAMS GANG YANG MED PAR PHYI'I KUN SPYOD PHAL PA LTAR STON CING, MNGON MTSAN CHUNG NGU'I THOG NAS DGE SBYOR KHO NAR 'BAD PA LA NANG GI YON TAN GI SGO NAS BTAGS PA DANG,
rows.wylie: ku sA li'i tshogs gsog skabs, ku sA li zhes pa dge ba can la 'jug pas nang gi yon tan sbas nas mkhas nyams grub nyams gang yang med par phyi'i kun spyod phal pa ltar ston cing, mngon mtshan chung ngu'i thog nas dge sbyor kho nar 'bad pa la nang gi yon tan gi sgo nas btags pa dang
rows.english: Next we gather the great goodness of Kusali.  The word kusali means goodness, and it refers to a person who conceals the high spiritual qualities she or he has within them.  In their outer actions they seem to be just a regular person; they make no show of being a sage or saint.  But in truth they give their entire strength to one thing, and one thing only: to the practice of virtue, with few signs to others of what they are doing.  And so the word kusali is applied to describe their inner spiritual qualities.

rows.acip: DE NAS BLA MA'I RNAL 'BYOR GYI BLA MA RNAMS KYI MDUN DU STON PA THUB PA'I DBANG PO LA 'GRO BA KUN GYIS SRI ZHU BYA BA'I 'OS SU GYUR PA DKON MCHOG SRI ZHU'I MGRON RGYUD SDE BZHI'I YI DAM, LONGS SPRUL GYI SANGS RGYAS, DE DAG GIS GSUNGS PA'I LUNG RTOGS KYI CHOS PO TI'I RNAM PA CAN, DE NYAMS SU LEN PA'I DGE 'DUN BYANG SEMS NYAN RANG RNAMS KYIS BSKOR BA,
rows.wylie: de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla ma rnams kyi mdun du ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la 'gro ba kun gyis sri zhu bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam, longs sprul gyi sangs rgyas, de dag gis gsungs pa'i lung rtogs kyi chos po ti'i rnam pa can, de nyams su len pa'i dge 'dun byang sems nyan rang rnams kyis bskor ba
rows.english: Next we visualize the Teacher, the Lord of the Able Ones, in front of the Lamas we have invited for the Practice of the Lama.  Surrounding Him are all the precious Jewels, the beings that we call the "Guests of Holy Service," for they are worthy objects of the holy service of all living kind. These guests include the Close Angels of all four secret groups; the Enjoyment and Emanation Bodies of the Buddhas; the Teachings they have spoken, both the physical Word and the realizations brought about by the Word, all in the form of volumes of scripture; and the spiritual community who puts these teachings into practice: Bodhisattvas, listeners, and self-made buddhas.

rows.acip: BLA MA'I DRUNG DU 'DI GA'I SINDH'U RA'I DBANG BZHI BYIN RLABS NOS BA NAS BZUNG 'DI'I GZHUNG DU GSAL BA'I DBANG BZHI LEN TSUL BSDUS PA THUN MONG BA'AM, ZHAL SHES DBANG BZHI RGYAS PA LEN TSUL THUN MONG MA YIN PA GANG RUNG ZHIG CHAG MED NYAMS SU LEN NUS NA GONG DU ZHUS PA LTAR DBANG GI CHU BO MA NUB PA ZHES BYIN RLABS KYI RGYUN MI NYAMS PA'I GNAD CHE BA YOD GSUNGS,
rows.wylie: bla ma'i drung du 'di ga'i sindhU ra'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs nos ba nas bzung 'di'i gzhung du gsal ba'i dbang bzhi len tshul bsdus pa thun mong ba'am, zhal shes dbang bzhi rgyas pa len tshul thun mong ma yin pa gang rung zhig chag med nyams su len nus na gong du zhus pa ltar dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa zhes byin rlabs kyi rgyun mi nyams pa'i gnad che ba yod gsungs
rows.english: Suppose you are able to make it all a part of your life; first you are granted the blessings of the four empowerments for this Angel in Her Sindhura world.  You keep to all Her practices from there on up, and you follow without fail one of the two ways of accepting the four Empowerments: either the regular, briefer one described in the scriptures of Her way; or else the one with the more detailed empowerments--the unique one--which you learn privately.  This has, said our Lama, a very vital importance.  This is what keeps the stream of the blessing from ever being lost; and this is what I was speaking about above, when I said that the stream of the empowerment should never have run dry. Third of the Private Instructions: Bringing the Lama Inside

rows.acip: 'DI NYID SKYABS MGON DAM PA THUGS RJE DANG BKA' DRIN TSE RABS THAMS CAD DU GZHAL BAR DKA' BA'I RDO RJE CAN GYI BLA MA KHYED LA SNYING THAG PA NAS 'BUL BA STE DBUL BAR BGYI, ZHES SNGAGS LUGS LA 'BREL SHIN TU CHE, ZHES PA 'DI LTA BU'I NYAMS LEN GYI SDOMS NI, TSIG NYUNG DON RGYAS MKHAS PA MGU BA BSKYED PA'I GNAS SAM SNYAM, DE NAS BRGYUD 'DEBS NGAG 'DON LTAR BYAS NAS GSOL BA SHUGS DRAG BTAB LA,
rows.wylie: 'di nyid skyabs mgon dam pa thugs rje dang bka' drin tshe rabs thams cad du gzhal bar dka' ba'i rdo rje can gyi bla ma khyed la snying thag pa nas 'bul ba ste dbul bar bgyi, zhes sngags lugs la 'brel shin tu che, zhes pa 'di lta bu'i nyams len gyi sdoms ni, tshig nyung don rgyas mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa'i gnas sam snyam, de nas brgyud 'debs ngag 'don ltar byas nas gsol ba shugs drag btab la
rows.english: From the bottom of your heart offer this mandala most especially to your Lama: "to You," to the one who holds the diamond, to your Savior and Protector, whose kindness and compassion over all of your lives is so difficult to even measure. Performing the mandala offering in these words has a deep connection with the way of the Secret Word.  It seems to me that the summary of all Buddhist practice contained in these lines--few in words yet vast in meaning--is something that would bring great pleasure to the wise.  Then make fierce supplications, as you recite the words of request to the lineage Lamas. The Blessing of the Four Empowerments

rows.acip: PHAR PHYIN THEG PA'I SKABS RANG CAG 'KHOR BAR 'KHOR BA'I RGYU BDAG 'DZIN MA RIG PA LA THUG PA LTAR GSANG SNGAGS KYI SKABS SU 'KHOR BAR 'KHOR BA'I RGYU SKYE SHI BAR DO GSUM LA THUG STE, RANG RE DE GSUM LA SKOR BA BSKOR NAS 'KHOR BAR 'KHYAMS PAS SNGAGS KYI SKABS 'DIR SBYANG GZHI SKYE SHI BAR DO GSUM LA BYED,
rows.wylie: phar phyin theg pa'i skabs rang cag 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgyu bdag 'dzin ma rig pa la thug pa ltar gsang sngags kyi skabs su 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgyu skye shi bar do gsum la thug ste, rang re de gsum la skor ba bskor nas 'khor bar 'khyams pas sngags kyi skabs 'dir sbyang gzhi skye shi bar do gsum la byed
rows.english: In the way of the perfections, we learn that the cause for our circling around in this circle of births ultimately traces to ignorance, to the grasping for an innate nature in things.  This finds a parallel in the way of the secret word, where the cause for our circling here comes down finally to these very three: birth, death, and the state between them.  You and I, all of us, spin around between these three; and so it is that we wander aimlessly in this wheel of life.  Thus the thing that we seek to purify in our practice here is the same three: birth, death, and the inbetween.

rows.wylie: de lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma gsum ni, sngon du byin rlabs kyi skabs, phyi'i rnal 'byor ma stim tshul, nang gi rnal 'byor ma bskyed tshul, gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma gsal 'debs tshul rnams ji lta ba bzhin du ngo sprad pa de'i rgyun skyong ba ste bskyed rdzogs gang la'ang dbang dus su brda sprad pa de kha'i rgyun nyams su len pa las, logs su bsgom tshul gang yang med pas
rows.english: When earlier on you receive the empowerment of blessing for these three types of Angels, you were introduced to the proper ways in which you melt the outer Angel down into you; give birth to the inner Angel; and visualize the secret Angel.  Afterwards you need to maintain this practice: regardless of whether you are working on the creation or the completion stage, your practice will be a continuation of what you were introduced to when you received your empowerment.  There is no other separate practice of meditation here at all.

rows.english: We will begin by discussing the stage of creation.  There are two steps to carrying out this level of practice. rows.acip: 'CHI BA'I DUS SU SKABS 'DIR PHYI DBUGS RAGS PA CHAD, NANG DBUGS CHUNG NGU ZHIG BSDAD YOD PAS NYAMS LEN GYI LAG RJES BSAM BLO GTONG RGYU DANG, THUGS DAM GSAL 'DEBS ZER BA RNAMS 'DI DUS DGOS GSUNGS,

rows.english: At this point in the process of death, the rough breath, the outer one, stops.  Inside, a very fine breath remains.  It is then, said our Lama, that we must--as they say--show the effects of our lifetime of practice, and concentrate our thoughts upon the ultimate state of mind.

rows.acip: DA LTA LAS DANG PO BA LA DE 'DRA'I BDE BA DNGOS SU MED KYANG THA MAL PA'I DBANG PO GNYIS SBYOR GYI BDE BA'I NYAMS LTA BU CI THON BYAS TE GTZO SEMS RAGS PA MOS PA YID BYED KYIS BDE BA'I NGO BOR BSKYED LA,
rows.wylie: da lta las dang po ba la de 'dra'i bde ba dngos su med kyang tha mal pa'i dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba'i nyams lta bu ci thon byas te gtso sems rags pa mos pa yid byed kyis bde ba'i ngo bor bskyed la
rows.english: Right now, beginners like you and I can't actually have this particular experience of bliss, but we can try to approximate the feeling by imagining some ordinary kind of pleasure, like the sensation when the two organs are coupled.  In this case the imagination, the wish that it could be, makes our main consciousness, the rough ordinary one, take on the nature of bliss.

rows.english: It is therefore extremely important to acquaint yourself with the original state which you must transform, and with that which you are going to use to transform it.  You must be able to recognize this and actually put it into practice.  Having just dissolved your Lama into the vam syllable at your heart, remain in a state of bliss and voidness.

rows.acip: DBU 'GYING NYAMS KYIS ZHAL DKYIL LAM TZAM RANG LA BSTAN CING, SPYAN GYIS YAR GZIGS PA LTA BU DGOS TSUL, ,ZHAL GA YON DU PHYOGS PAS GA YON PA'I KUN SPYOD GTZO BOR MDZAD PA DANG, THABS SHES GNYIS NAS GA YON PA SHES RAB STONG PHYOGS LA RTZAL DU BTON TE DE LA DUS RTAG TU MNYAM PAR BZHAG PA MTSON,
rows.wylie: dbu 'gying nyams kyis zhal dkyil lam tsam rang la bstan cing, spyan gyis yar gzigs pa lta bu dgos tshul, ,zhal ga yon du phyogs pas ga yon pa'i kun spyod gtso bor mdzad pa dang, thabs shes gnyis nas ga yon pa shes rab stong phyogs la rtsal du bton te de la dus rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa mtshon
rows.english: Our Lama described how the Angel should be smiling, with Her face turned a bit towards us in an alluring way, eyes looking up.  Her head is facing to the left, which is to show that Her main practice is acting leftways; that of the traditional pair of method and wisdom She is concerned with the left side, the wisdom or emptiness side; that She has gained mastery in this side, and that She is eternally wrapped in deep meditation upon this side.

rows.acip: SNGA LO KHRID KYI SKABS 'JIGS DUS GNYIS BDE MCHOG LHA DRUG CU RTZA GNYIS PA LTAR PHYAG BZHI PA BSHAD RUNG, DE RJES KHO BO LA DOGS PA BYUNG BA LTAR, RJE T'A RA N'A THAS KYANG SGOM RGYU'I LHA LAS ZHABS 'OG GI SROG CHAGS GZI BRJID CHE BSGOM NA DE MI THUB PA'I SKYON 'BYUNG NYEN YOD GSUNGS PAS LAS DANG PO PA RNAMS KYIS NYAMS SU LEN BDE ZHING DOGS GNAS CHUNG BA YIN,
rows.wylie: snga lo khrid kyi skabs 'jigs dus gnyis bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa ltar phyag bzhi pa bshad rung, de rjes kho bo la dogs pa byung ba ltar, rje tA ra nA thas kyang sgom rgyu'i lha las zhabs 'og gi srog chags gzi brjid che bsgom na de mi thub pa'i skyon 'byung nyen yod gsungs pas las dang po pa rnams kyis nyams su len bde zhing dogs gnas chung ba yin
rows.english: It is true that last year, when I was teaching you about the beings called Frightener and the Lady of the Night, I told you that each of them had four arms--similar to the 62 Angels of the secret world of Highest Bliss.  Later though I came to have doubts about this point. I found that Master Taranatha has said that--if you visualize these beings underfoot as having great glory and beauty--then you might have the problem of thinking that you are incapable of overcoming them.  And so I think that is easier for young practitioners, and there will be less trouble, if you were to visualize them as having two arms.

rows.acip: YE SHES KYI ME'I DBUS SU GA-YON DU 'GYING BA'I RNAM PAR BZHUGS PA NI SGEG PA, 'JIGS DUS GNYIS MNAN PAS NI DPA' BA STE SKU'I NYAMS DANG, ZHAL HE BYAS PA LTA BUS RGOD PA, MCHE BA CUNG ZAD GTZIGS PAS 'JIGS PA STE GSUNG GI NYAMS DANG, SPYAN DKYUS RING BA SNYING RJE DANG, HUR PAG TU GZIGS PAS RNGAMS PA NI THUGS KYI NYAMS TE NYAMS DRUG DANG LDAN PA,
rows.wylie: ye shes kyi me'i dbus su ga-yon du 'gying ba'i rnam par bzhugs pa ni sgeg pa, 'jigs dus gnyis mnan pas ni dpa' ba ste sku'i nyams dang, zhal he byas pa lta bus rgod pa, mche ba cung zad gtsigs pas 'jigs pa ste gsung gi nyams dang, spyan dkyus ring ba snying rje dang, hur pag tu gzigs pas rngams pa ni thugs kyi nyams te nyams drug dang ldan pa
rows.english: The Diamond Angel possesses six different aspects. The fact that She is standing in the middle of a wisdom fire and twisting slightly to the left represents that She is alluring.  The fact that She is stamping on top of the Frightener and the Lady of the Night represents Her fearlessness. These are the two aspect of Her body. Her subtle half-smile represents that She can be wild, and baring Her fangs represents that She can be frightening. These are the two aspects of Her speech. Her doe eyes represent Her compassion, and the intensity of Her gaze represents Her ferocity. These are the two aspects of Her thoughts.

rows.acip: SPYIR GSANG STE SPYOD PAS 'GRUB PAS NA GSANG SNGAGS ZHES GSUNGS ZHING, KHYAD PAR LUS DKYIL SOGS GSANG BA CHE RIGS BSHAD NA RANG GI DNGOS GRUB NYAMS PA'I RGYU MTHAR THUG YIN LA, NGAG 'DON LUS DKYIL BKOD STABS DPE 'DI YANG SU RUNG RUNG LA MI STON PAR BKA' BRGYA DAM PAR BYED PA NI GNAD SHIN TU CHE'O,
rows.wylie: spyir gsang ste spyod pas 'grub pas na gsang sngags zhes gsungs zhing, khyad par lus dkyil sogs gsang ba che rigs bshad na rang gi dngos grub nyams pa'i rgyu mthar thug yin la, ngag 'don lus dkyil bkod stabs dpe 'di yang su rung rung la mi ston par bka' brgya dam par byed pa ni gnad shin tu che'o
rows.english: Now as a general note, the meaning of the Tibetan word sang-ngak, or way of the secret word, is "that which is performed or attained by acting in secret."  This is especially true for the more secret practices such as the secret world of the body. Speaking of these things to other people is the ultimate cause for the degeneration of your own attainments.  Insofar as I have set down a description of the secret world of the body in this recitation text, you should not show it to just anyone; but rather you should keep it under tight lock and key.  This point is extremely important.

rows.english: Despite this statement, the teachings on the Wheel of Time say that the outer four elements and so on are referred to as the "outer Wheel of Time"; the body which is subsumed by a being's sentience is called the "inner Wheel of Time"; and the spiritual levels and paths which we are meant to practice are called the "Wheel of Time which is beyond."

And then may your heads split open!�  Here the unusual Tibetan spelling khos is a form of bkos or, more simply, gas--meaning split open.

rows.english: The whole line, according to one tradition of commentary, means "I am the holy body, holy speech, and holy mind of each and every Buddha, and bodhisattva, and man and woman Warrior in the vast myriad of paradises in every direction of space; I am all of them, joined in a single being."

rows.acip: RANG GIS THOG MED NAS BSAGS PA'I SDIG SGRIB DANG DAM TSIG NYAMS CHAG THAMS CAD BSHAGS PA 'BUL, 'DI PHYI'I 'DOD DON GSOL BA 'DEBS RGYU GANG YOD SNYING THAG PA NAS BTAB STE ZHAL GYIS BZHES PAR BSAM NA
rows.wylie: rang gis thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bshags pa 'bul, 'di phyi'i 'dod don gsol ba 'debs rgyu gang yod snying thag pa nas btab ste zhal gyis bzhes par bsam na
rows.english: Next make an offering to these Holy Beings, by opening yourself up and admitting each and every bad deed and obstacle, and every incident in which you demeaned or broke your pledges, collected and stored within yourself for time with no beginning.  Then make a request from deep within your heart that these Beings assist you in achieving each and every goal you hope for, whether for this life or the next.  Think to yourself then that They graciously accept and agree.

rows.acip: PHRENG THAG NI GZHON NU MA MA NYAMS PAS BKAL BA'I BAL SKUD DGU SGRIL DGOS, DE YANG BSNYEN PA SOGS LA PHRENG SKUD NANG BSGRIM, MTHU GTONG BA LA PHYI BSGRIM DGOS PAR GSUNGS YOD,

rows.english: The string for the rosary should be made of nine intertwined woolen threads, braided together by a young woman who has not lost her virginity. rows.acip: TSE DANG NOR SGRUB PAR 'DOD PA, 'GO NAD YAMS RIMS SOGS LUS KYI NA TSA DANG, SEMS KYI SDUG BSNGAL ZHI BA, SAD SER MU GE SOGS ZHI BA, CHAR 'BEBS GCOD SOGS SGRUB PA, GZA' KLU RGYAL PO LA SOGS PA'I SDE BRGYAD GDUG PA CAN GYI GNOD PA SEL BA, MI NOR 'GUGS PA SOGS DBANG SDUD KYI RIGS DANG, GSAD BSKRAD DBYE RMONGS SOGS LAS RAB 'BYAMS GANG BSGRUB PAR 'DOD KYANG SNGAGS 'DI NYID LA 'BAD PAS MCHOG TU 'GYUR ZHING,
rows.wylie: tshe dang nor sgrub par 'dod pa, 'go nad yams rims sogs lus kyi na tsha dang, sems kyi sdug bsngal zhi ba, sad ser mu ge sogs zhi ba, char 'bebs gcod sogs sgrub pa, gza' klu rgyal po la sogs pa'i sde brgyad gdug pa can gyi gnod pa sel ba, mi nor 'gugs pa sogs dbang sdud kyi rigs dang, gsad bskrad dbye rmongs sogs las rab 'byams gang bsgrub par 'dod kyang sngags 'di nyid la 'bad pas mchog tu 'gyur zhing
rows.english: Name any kind of ritual work there is: say you want to lengthen your life, or get rich; to put an end to some bodily illness, headaches or contagions, fevers or anything else; to stop some mental suffering; to make frost, and hail, and famines, and everything of the sort go away; to cause rain to fall, or commit termination, or the like; to clear away harm caused by any of the eight groups of evil, related to the planets, or to the serpentines, to the government of the land or the rest; to accomplish any of the acts that bring you power, bringing in worldly wealth and such; killing or frightening away or splitting or confusing, anything.  There are a countless myriad of such deeds, and the highest method for accomplishing whichever you may wish to do is to make strong effort in the secret words found right here.

rows.wylie: bsnyen tshad ni, sa lugs la 'bum phrag bzhi sogs dang, sindhu ra'i sgrub pa byed na 'bru 'bum tshar nyer gsum bya bar gsungs la, rje rin po che ni 'bum phrag gis tshog pas, rdzogs ldan la ni bgrang bya gcig ,ces sogs gsungs pa las rab 'byams sgrub pa la dgongs kyi
rows.english: As for how many times we repeat the mantra during our tantric retreats, the tradition of the Sakyas is that we do 400,000 repetitions, and such.  It's been stated that, if we are undertaking the Practice of Sindhura, then we do 23 sets of a hundred thousand of the syllables.  Je Rinpoche makes that statement that we should "Accumulate a hundred thousand, for one complete count," but all He means to say here is that we should repeat the mantra zillions and zillions of times.

rows.acip: SNGON DU LUS GNAD 'CHA' DGOS TE, LUS 'DRONGS NA RTZA 'DRONGS SHING, DE LA BRTEN NAS RLUNG 'GRO 'ONG BDE LA, DE BDE BAS RLUNG SEMS 'JUG PA GCIG PAS SEMS LAS RUNG DU 'GYUR BA'I PHYIR SA CHEN GYIS, RTEN 'BREL LUS LA BSGRIGS PAS NYAMS RTOGS SEMS LA SKYE, ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR,
rows.wylie: sngon du lus gnad 'cha' dgos te, lus 'drongs na rtsa 'drongs shing, de la brten nas rlung 'gro 'ong bde la, de bde bas rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pas sems las rung du 'gyur ba'i phyir sa chen gyis, rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas nyams rtogs sems la skye, zhes gsungs pa ltar
rows.english: To bring with you must put your body in the proper position.  If your body is straight then your channels will be straight; and if your channels are straight, the winds will come and go with ease.  The winds and the mind move in tandem, so if your winds are moving nicely you will be able to get your mind to do whatever you want it to do.  It is just as Sachen says: "If you get off to a good start with your body, then personal realizations will come to your mind."

rows.english: The visualization of the mental recitation though is more subtle than that of the first of the incidental practices of the stage of completion. His statement to this effect, in the considered opinion of the Great Being, reflected a case where the intent of the secret teaching had shown itself to the author as private revelation.  As such, the great Father and Son--Ngulchu and His disciple--carried Their practice out in this same way as well.

rows.english: Based on this, Lord Sachen gave an abbreviated description of how to carry out the practice in Eleven Yogas. rows.english: Then the fire gets bigger, and blazes up and pierces the vam@@@ letter as a spear piercing a bag of milk. rows.english: Kenchen Ngawang Chudrak has said that the way in which the experiences of bliss and emptiness move is the opposite as I have described above.  The way I received this teaching from the Lamas of our lineage is however how I described it here.  It is true however that the way this practice is written down in the recitation text is close to how Kenchen describes it.  I think it would be okay if men were to practice it in the way that Kenchen described, and if women were to do so as described here, but you should look into this and research it later on yourselves--it's a point to be further checked.

rows.english: What kind of person is suitable to undertake this practice?  First you must be relying properly upon a qualified spiritual guide, the very root of the path.  And then from this person you must have been granted the shared teachings of the greater way--teachings on the steps of the path the enlightenment.  You must be putting these teachings into practice and at the least be beginning to have some experiential realizations of renunciation, the wish for enlightenment, and correct view.

rows.english: First we will cover what you should do before you start your retreat.  Whether or not your retreat takes off all depends on getting ready by collecting together good energy and purifying yourself of negative energy.  One way to do this is by performing certain of the following practices 100,000 times, according to the advices of the oral tradition of the Virtuous Ones, the Gelukpa: �	Go for refuge �	Recite the secret words of the Hundred Syllables �	Do prostrations, in conjunction with confessing your broken vows �	Make mandala offerings �	Make supplications with a Lama practice �	Make waterbowl offerings �	Do the Diamond Recitation of Pledge �	Make fire offerings to the Consuming Angel �	Make holy statues or pressed satsa images

rows.english: On the first night of your retreat start with the Practice of Taking Nectar and continue all the way up to the final verses of joyful fortune, using the unique ritual text for reaching the Angel entitled the Short Path to Great Bliss.  You should also perform the Offering of the Gathering and the final dedications, prayers, and so on.  Having gone carefully through all the practices that take you up to bedtime, start off on the Practice of Sleeping.

rows.wylie: de ltar thor thun, snga thun, dgong thun, srod thun te thun bzhir nyams su len cing , thun gyi ring thung rang gi khams dang mos pa dang bstun, mtshams kyi mgo mjug gnyis lhod pa dang dkyil du grim pa'i bsnyen sgrub nas 'dra ba bya dgos, nyi ma 'char nub kyi zer kha gnyis dang , nyin gung mtshan gung gnyis te ting nge 'dzin 'jig pa'i dus bzhi la thun mtshams khel bar bya
rows.english: In this way you should follow the practice of the four sessions of pre-dawn, morning, evening, and night.  The length of each session should be in keeping with your own propensities and drive.  You have to make your retreat like a grain of barley--be more relaxed at the beginning and end, and work especially hard during the middle part.  Be sure that the four times when concentration is broken--when the sun breaks the horizon at dawn and dusk, and also the mid-points of day and night, meaning noon and midnight--fall inbetween your session times.

Thus it is critical that you undertake these with intense effort, as laid forth in the book of instructions.

rows.english: Neither signs of progress nor powers will come to those who allow the three pledges to degenerate by: (1) Losing the clarity of the Angel you have become. (2) Reciting the secret words in an imperfect way. (3) Being distracted in your meditative concentration.

rows.english: You shouldn't have great expectations wherein you think you are going to have miraculous experiences or dreams in which you meet the Angel face to face, or receive final prophetic words form Her lips, or things of the like. rows.english: It was written at the repeated insistence of that layperson with lifetime vows, Dorje Rabten, and by the sponsor of the carving: the full monk Tupten Ngudrup, a member of the Tsawa College of Sera Je Monastery.  And it was composed by myself, Jampa Tendzin Trinle Gyatso--the one they call by the name of the Incarnation of Pabongka.  The scribe who first wrote it out was Dakden Punhla of Chamdo.  May goodness reign! *Translator's note: In the original Tibetan text, there is an additional section inserted at this point which repeats, almost word for word, sections of the Stairway to Heaven text by Dechen Nyingpo which forms the first reading for this twelfth course of the Tantric Series.  We have therefore not included that text here, but continue on to advices on coming out of retreat contained at the very end of the present work.  There are a very small number of points found in this middle piece that are not included in the Stairway, and these are specifically covered in the homework masters to the course. rows.acip: THUN MTSAMS SU'ANG SGO GSUM GYI BYA BAR RTOG DPYOD KYIS NYAMS LEN DANG MI 'BRAL BA'I 'PHEN PA BZANG PO BTANG, GANG SNANG, RNAL 'BYOR MAR BLTA BA NGO BO LAS RNAM PA GSAL MI DGOS,

rows.english: Approach each day with the pure intention that you will never fail to bring these practices into your daily life; to accomplish this, examine carefully everything you do or say or think during the periods between your meditation sessions. rows.acip: 'KHYER SO GSUM GYI RNAL 'BYOR LA GNAS NA MA MTHAR SGO GSUM GYI KUN SPYOD LUNG MA BSTAN RNAMS KYANG DGE BAR BSGYUR NUS TE, ,SHR'I HE RU KA:'I GO 'PHANG GNAS, ,YAN LAG GIS NI BSKYOD PA DANG, ,TSIG GI RAB 'BYAMS JI SNYED PA, ,DE SNYED PHYAG RGYA GSANG SNGAGS YIN,
rows.wylie: 'khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor la gnas na ma mthar sgo gsum gyi kun spyod lung ma bstan rnams kyang dge bar bsgyur nus te, ,shrI he ru ka:'i go 'phang gnas, ,yan lag gis ni bskyod pa dang, ,tshig gi rab 'byams ji snyed pa, ,de snyed phyag rgya gsang sngags yin
rows.english: When you maintain the practice of the three perspectives, then at the very least it has the power to transform the neutral actions you do in your body, speech, and mind--changing all of them into virtue.  For it is spoken: If you maintain the state of Shri Heruka, Then each and every motion of limb And all the syllables you ever utter Become sacred gestures, and deep secret words.

rows.english: In the Great Book on the Steps of the Secret Word, an entire presentation is devoted to those activities--such as the practice of the three perspectives--which you carry out between meditation sessions. Therefore those of you with high intellect must definitely go and commune with this work, and then apply its teachings to your daily practice.

rows.acip: THUN MTSAMS KYI DGE SBYOR RNAMS SHIN TU GAL CHE BAS DE RNAMS NYAMS LEN GYI RTZIS ZIN PAR MA BYAS NA TSE PHAL CHER DON MED DU 'DA' BAS NAN TAN LA BLO CI NUS KYIS 'BAD PAR BYA'O,,

rows.english: The attempts we make to accomplish virtue in the times between our formal sessions are extremely important; and so if we fail to imbue them with the a continued sense of practice we are for the most part wasting our life in the meaningless. rows.acip: SNYAN RGYUD TSAD MA BZHI LDAN ZHES BYA BA 'DI LA DBYE NA RLABS KYI BRGYUD PA MA NYAMS PA ZHES PA SINDHU RA'I BYIN RLABS RNAM PAR DAG PA THOB,

rows.english: When they speak, by the way, of the oral lineage possessing four types of integrity, one of the divisions is that the line of the blessing should not have been broken.  This means that those of the lineage should have received a pure form so the blessing of the sindhura.

rows.acip: TSOGS 'KHOR BYED PA 'DI DAM TSIG NYAMS CHAG SKONG BA'I MCHOG DANG, BAR CHAD ZHI BA'I THABS KYI GTZO BO YANG YIN, 'DI GNAD SMIN MA BYUNG NA SHIN TU NYEN CHE BAS RJE YAB SRAS KYIS TSOGS KYI YIG CHA DNGOS SU MA MDZAD PA,
rows.wylie: tshogs 'khor byed pa 'di dam tshig nyams chag skong ba'i mchog dang, bar chad zhi ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo yang yin, 'di gnad smin ma byung na shin tu nyen che bas rje yab sras kyis tshogs kyi yig cha dngos su ma mdzad pa
rows.english: This practice of the Circle of Gathering is the highest means that exists for fulfilling those pledges which you have let decline, or broken altogether.  It is also one of the principal methods for ending obstacles.  If though the crucial points of the practice are not carried out in the proper way, it can be very dangerous, and for this reason no such practice was written down directly in the various manuals for gathering by the Lord and His spiritual Sons.

rows.acip: GNYIS PA NI, GZHUNG DU RJE SANGS RGYAS DPAL BZANG GI BDAG 'JUG BZHIN DU NYAMS SU LEN PAR GSUNGS LA, YIG CHA DER TSOGS 'KHOR BYED TSUL ZUR TZAM LAS PHYI ROL MCHOD PA BYA TSUL MA GSUNGS SHING PHYI ROL MCHOD PA BDE MCHOG TU LAG MCHOD DANG, GRU GSUM MCHOD PA BYA BAR GSUNGS SHING, TSOGS 'KHOR NI DNGOS BSTAN BDAG 'JUG LEN PA YIN NA'ANG, DA LTA'I PHYAG BZHES 'DI 'PHRAL GYI NYAMS LEN LA GNAD 'GAG CHE BAS,
rows.wylie: gnyis pa ni, gzhung du rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi bdag 'jug bzhin du nyams su len par gsungs la, yig cha der tshogs 'khor byed tshul zur tsam las phyi rol mchod pa bya tshul ma gsungs shing phyi rol mchod pa bde mchog tu lag mchod dang, gru gsum mchod pa bya bar gsungs shing, tshogs 'khor ni dngos bstan bdag 'jug len pa yin na'ang, da lta'i phyag bzhes 'di 'phral gyi nyams len la gnad 'gag che bas
rows.english: This brings us to the second of the secondary practices--the outside offering, or yoga of the gathering.  In the text it says that we should perform this practice as we find it in the ritual by Lord Sangye Pelsang for taking oneself into the secret world.  In that work though no instructions are given for performing the outer offering, aside from just a bit on how to do the Circle of Gathering.  What is stated is that in the teachings of Highest Bliss we perform the offering of the hand, and the offering of the three corners, for the outer offering.  The explicit form of Circle of Gathering is to take oneself into the secret world; but in current practice the immediate ritual is most critical.

rows.acip: 'DI LA 'BYUNG PO THAMS CAD PA'I SNGAGS ZHES GSUNGS PAS, SGRA YANG BA'I DBANG LA 'BYUNG PO NI 'KHOR 'DAS THAMS CAD LA 'JUG PA DANG, BLA MED LA SNOD BCUD THAMS CAD LA DAG PA RAB 'BYAMS 'BA' ZHIG TU 'CHAR BAS 'DAS MA 'DAS BLOS BZHAG PA TZAM YIN PA DANG,
rows.wylie: 'di la 'byung po thams cad pa'i sngags zhes gsungs pas, sgra yang ba'i dbang la 'byung po ni 'khor 'das thams cad la 'jug pa dang, bla med la snod bcud thams cad la dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu 'char bas 'das ma 'das blos bzhag pa tsam yin pa dang
rows.english: Remember that this particular mantra has been called the "Mantra for All Spirits"--the name itself is meant in a lenient sort of way, where "spirits" refers to both those who are still in the suffering world and those who are already beyond it.  Here in the system of the Unsurpassed class, every planet in the universe--and every being every planet contains--are appearing to us as nothing less than myriad forms of total purity.  As such, the terms "beyond the suffering world" and "not yet beyond it" are nothing more than our own projections.

As such, the terms \"beyond the suffering world\" and \"not yet beyond it\" are nothing more than our own projections."}

rows.acip: GTZO 'KHOR THAMS CAD KYI RIGS BDAG GI THUGS KAR ZLA GDAN LA H'Um GI MTHAR YI GE BRGYA PAS BSKOR BA LAS BDUD RTZI'I RGYUN BABS RANG GIS MCHOD RDZAS SOGS LA MI GTZANG BA'I NYAMS GRIB PHOG PA THAMS CAD DAG PAR BSAM LA,
rows.wylie: gtso 'khor thams cad kyi rigs bdag gi thugs kar zla gdan la hUM gi mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gis mchod rdzas sogs la mi gtsang ba'i nyams grib phog pa thams cad dag par bsam la
rows.english: Now see that the central Angel, and all Her circle, are the hung letter on the moon disk within the holy heart of the Lord of Enlightened Kind; and that this letter is surrounded by the Mantra of the Hundred Syllables.  A stream of deathless nectar now falls from the letters, which allows us to clear the offering substances and such of any impure influence or obstacles which may have infected them.

rows.acip: MCHOD RDZAS MA 'BYOR BA DANG 'BYOR KYANG PHUD NYAMS PA SOGS MI DGYES PA GANG YANG RUNG BA BDAG GI BLO GROS RMONGS PA'I DBANG GIS RANG GIS BGYIS PA DANG, GZHAN BGYID DU STZAL BA THAMS CAD BZOD PAR GSOL SNYAM DU BZOD GSOL BYA,
rows.wylie: mchod rdzas ma 'byor ba dang 'byor kyang phud nyams pa sogs mi dgyes pa gang yang rung ba bdag gi blo gros rmongs pa'i dbang gis rang gis bgyis pa dang, gzhan bgyid du stsal ba thams cad bzod par gsol snyam du bzod gsol bya
rows.english: Then try to think of anything during the ceremony that may have failed to please the Guests: perhaps you did not have enough resources to purchase proper offerings, or perhaps you did have the resources but something went wrong when you presented the first part, or something of the like.  Then make supplication where you are begging these Holy Beings, in your mind, to forgive you for whatever your yourself might have done wrong--or anything you may have induced someone else to do wrong--during the ceremony, all due to your own gross lack of understanding.

rows.acip: 'DI TZAM LA'ANG RTOG GE'I RIGS PA DANG, RTOGS PA MTHO NYAMS SOGS KYIS MI BRTZI BA MI RUNG STE, DPER NA, YAR NGO LA ZLA BA'I DKAR CHA YAR 'PHEL BA LTAR TSOGS GNYIS GONG 'PHEL DU 'GYUR BA DANG, MAR NGO LA DKAR CHA MAR 'GRIB PA LTAR MI MTHUN PHYOGS 'GRIB PA'I RTEN 'BREL GYI GNAD DANG SBYAR TE
rows.wylie: 'di tsam la'ang rtog ge'i rigs pa dang, rtogs pa mtho nyams sogs kyis mi brtsi ba mi rung ste, dper na, yar ngo la zla ba'i dkar cha yar 'phel ba ltar tshogs gnyis gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang, mar ngo la dkar cha mar 'grib pa ltar mi mthun phyogs 'grib pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad dang sbyar te
rows.english: Incidentally, it is totally improper to disregard points like this because you think they are illogical, or because you start thinking some realizations are very high and some are not so high, or anything of the like.  You can take the example of another special key for our practice, the auspicious conditions of the moon for certain activities.  The period while the moon is waxing represents an auspicious time for building up the two collections: they expand just as the white part of the moon grows during this part of the month. The period while the moon is waning represents an auspicious time for reducing all the problems that work against our practice: they lessen in the same way that the white part of the moon shrinks at this time.

rows.acip: PHYI'I MKHA' SPYOD GTZO BOR BSGRUB NA 'DI'I BSKYED RIM LA SBYANGS TE MYONG BA THON PAR BYED DGOS PA LAS, TSE 'DIR RDZOGS RIM LA SLOB MI DGOS, PHYI MAR MKHA' SPYOD KYI RTEN LA RDZOGS RIM GYI LAM NYAMS SU LON NUS PA BYA,
rows.wylie: phyi'i mkha' spyod gtso bor bsgrub na 'di'i bskyed rim la sbyangs te myong ba thon par byed dgos pa las, tshe 'dir rdzogs rim la slob mi dgos, phyi mar mkha' spyod kyi rten la rdzogs rim gyi lam nyams su lon nus pa bya
rows.english: If your practice is aimed primarily at reaching the outer Heaven of the Angel, then you must train yourself in these steps of the stage of creation, until you achieve a total mastery of them--but you need not in this life train in the stage of completion.  You will have achieved the ability to carry out the various paths of the completion stage in your next life, using the body and mind that you have then in the Angel's Heaven.

rows.english: The entire explanation of the stage of creation up to this point came under the heading of analyzing and trying to come to some conclusions about the things to be meditated upon, using the traditional methods of learning and contemplation.  Here now are some notes on the second heading of this stage, which concerns the various steps of how you should hold your mind on selected points. We explained earlier a number of subjects such as how one had to be sure to hold their mind on whatever part of these instructions they had received in the teaching on that particular day.  At best, we do so by reviewing the day's teaching four times over, and at the very least we review once all that we have heard that day.  Carry all this out as described above.

rows.acip: DA DUNG LE LO MI BYA BAR NYAMS LEN CHAG MED BYAS NAS BLO SNYING BRANG GSUM GTAD NYEN CHE DUS SU SKYOB PA DKON MCHOG GSUM YIN PAS MA 'ONGS PA NA BAR DOR DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO RNAMS BYON TE RANG NYID SENG GE'I KHRI LA BZHAG, GDUGS DANG RGYAL MTSAN LA SOGS PA DANG ROL MO'I BYE BRAG SNA TSOGS DANG BCAS TE BSU BA MDZAD PAR BDE MCHOG RTZA RGYUD LAS GSUNGS LA,

rows.english: But that doesn't mean that you should then just abandon yourself to spiritual sloth.  Keep up your practice, without missing a single day.  Let it consume your thoughts; let it fill your heart; let it beat within your breast.  When the moment of greatest peril arrives, the Three Jewels will protect you.  And so in the future, as you pass through the realm between death and birth, the Warriors and Their holy Ladies will come to you.  They will lead you to the lion throne, and seat you there.  They will celebrate your arrival by raising dharma parasols and victory banners and all the like all around you; the air itself will explode in every kind of victorious song.  All this is promised, in the root secret text of Highest Bliss.

rows.english: You are a person who possesses the extraordinary good karma to have access to the fast path we've described in these pages: you have here in your own hands this one unsurpassed path, ready for you to practice. Come seat yourself at the feast that awaits you: focus on the highest spiritual goal of all, the one thing you always wished for.  Come, throw yourself into Her practice, and have your fill.  These parting words of advice do I offer you, straight from the core of my heart.

rows.acip: BLA MA'I KHRID RGYUN SKABS 'DI YIN GYI ZHAL GSAL MA BYUNG, BSKYED RIM RNAL 'BYOR BCU GCIG 'DIS NI RAB BZLAS SGOM GYIS GROL BA, 'BRING SINDHU RA'I SGRUB PAS GROL BA, THA MA 'CHI KHAR RNAL 'BYOR MAS RJES SU 'ZIN PA 'PHO BAS BGROD PA, YANG MTHA' SKYE BA BRGYUD NAS MKHA' SPYOD SOGS 'GRUB PA'I GANG ZAG THAMS CAD KYIS NYAMS SU LEN PA GAL CHE,
rows.wylie: bla ma'i khrid rgyun skabs 'di yin gyi zhal gsal ma byung, bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig 'dis ni rab bzlas sgom gyis grol ba, 'bring sindhu ra'i sgrub pas grol ba, tha ma 'chi khar rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'zin pa 'pho bas bgrod pa, yang mtha' skye ba brgyud nas mkha' spyod sogs 'grub pa'i gang zag thams cad kyis nyams su len pa gal che
rows.english: This is the section as it is normally given according to the teaching tradition of our Lamas; but I haven't received clarifications on it.  If people apply themselves to these eleven yogas of the stage of creation, then those of highest capacity will reach liberation through the practices of recitation and meditation.  Those of medium capacity will be freed through the practice of sindhura.  Those of least capacity are taken into the care of the Diamond Angel at the moment of death, travelling the path through the practice of sending on their consciousness.  And those who are lower than low in their capacity attain the Heaven of the Angel and other goals over a series of future lives.  As such, it's important for people of all capacities to exert themselves in the practice of these eleven yogas.

rows.acip: ,ZHES LAM THUN MONG BAS RGYUD SBYANGS TE BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS KYIS RTZIS MA ZIN PA DANG, LAM NYAMS SU LEN TSUL THE TSOM GYI SGRO 'DOGS MA CHOD PA DANG, BKA' BZHIN DU NI MI SPYOD PA DAM TSIG DANG SDOM PA MI BSRUNG PA DANG, LHA DANG BLA MA'I GDAMS NGAG SOGS LA DAD PA MA THOB NA DNGOS GRUB MI 'GRUB PAS DE DAG LA 'BAD PA GAL CHE BA YIN TE,
rows.wylie: zhes lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs te byang chub kyi sems kyis rtsis ma zin pa dang, lam nyams su len tshul the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs ma chod pa dang, bka' bzhin du ni mi spyod pa dam tshig dang sdom pa mi bsrung pa dang, lha dang bla ma'i gdams ngag sogs la dad pa ma thob na dngos grub mi 'grub pas de dag la 'bad pa gal che ba yin te
rows.english: These lines are describing, first, practitioners who have failed to prepare their minds with the path which is shared, and whose hearts are not imbued then by the Wish for enlightenment.  Then it speaks of those who have failed to resolve their doubts about how the path should be put into practice.  Next it describes those who fail to follow the directions they've been given: who fail to honor their pledges and vows.  And then finally it mentions those who have no faith in things like the advices they receive from the Angels and Lamas.  People like this, the verse is saying, will never achieve their spiritual goals; and as such it is crucial for us to put forth great efforts in doing the opposite in each case.

rows.acip: RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAS BLA MA MDZAD PA DANG, DER MA ZAD SPRUL SKU'I SANGS RGYAS KYI ZHING RNAMS LA SONG STE CHOS ZHUS NYAMS SU BLANGS NAS MYUR DU BCU GSUM RDO RJE 'DZIN PA'I SA THOB PAR 'GYUR TE,
rows.wylie: rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bla ma mdzad pa dang, der ma zad sprul sku'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams la song ste chos zhus nyams su blangs nas myur du bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob par 'gyur te
rows.english: The Diamond Queen herself acts as your Teacher; and you have as well the ability to travel to other Buddha paradises where Enlightened Ones are manifesting emanation bodies; here you request Their teachings, put them into practice, and thus achieve the thirteenth of the spiritual levels: the Level of the One Who Holds the Diamond.
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS13", "acip": "RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAS BLA MA MDZAD PA DANG, DER MA ZAD SPRUL SKU'I SANGS RGYAS KYI ZHING RNAMS LA SONG STE CHOS ZHUS NYAMS SU BLANGS NAS MYUR DU BCU GSUM RDO RJE 'DZIN PA'I SA THOB PAR 'GYUR TE,", "wylie": "rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bla ma mdzad pa dang, der ma zad sprul sku'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams la song ste chos zhus nyams su blangs nas myur du bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob par 'gyur te", "english": "The Diamond Queen herself acts as your Teacher; and you have as well the ability to travel to other Buddha paradises where Enlightened Ones are manifesting emanation bodies; here you request Their teachings, put them into practice, and thus achieve the thirteenth of the spiritual levels: the Level of the One Who Holds the Diamond."}

rows.acip: SINDHU RA NI RGYA SKAD YIN LA BOD SKAD DU LI KHRI, LANGGA NI GONG BZHIN, RO LDAN NI DUR KHROD YIN PAS DER SGRUB PA BYAS NAS PHYOGS MED KYI YUL KUN TU MNYUL BA STE, 'KHYAMS PAS GANG ZAG GI MDZOD SPUR STE,
rows.wylie: sindhu ra ni rgya skad yin la bod skad du li khri, langga ni gong bzhin, ro ldan ni dur khrod yin pas der sgrub pa byas nas phyogs med kyi yul kun tu mnyul ba ste, 'khyams pas gang zag gi mdzod spur ste
rows.english: The word "sindhura" as He uses it here in His verse is the Sanskrit, which corresponds in Tibetan to what we call li-tri, or an orange-colored powder.  When He mentions langali, it has the same meaning as we discussed above.  The "home of the dead" that Master Tsarchen speaks of is the charnel ground which we've been talking about.  First you "practice" there, and "then go wandering off,"--moving randomly--to wherever your quest may take you: to "places far and near."  And then, as He mentions, something happens between the brows of "the one."

rows.acip: DES DA DUNG LE LO MI BYA BAR NYAMS LEN CHAG MED DU BYAS NAS GLO SNYING BRANG GSUM GTAD NA BAR DOR DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO'I BSU BAR BDE MCHOG RTZA RGYUD LAS GSUNGS PAS BAR DO'I 'JIGS SKRAG SOGS MYONG MI DGOS SHING MYUR BA'I THABS 'PHO BA'I RNAL 'BYOR NYAMS SU LEN PA LA
rows.wylie: des da dung le lo mi bya bar nyams len chag med du byas nas glo snying brang gsum gtad na bar dor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu bar bde mchog rtsa rgyud las gsungs pas bar do'i 'jigs skrag sogs myong mi dgos shing myur ba'i thabs 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la
rows.english: But this doesn't mean that a person like this should just give up.  Keep up your practices in an unbroken stream, devoting yourself to them with every inch of your heart and soul.  And then, as it is stated in the root tantra of Highest Bliss, you will be greeted in the inbetween state by the Warriors and their Angel mates.  But be aware that there is another path which does not require that you undergo experiences such as the terror of dying from this life and passing into this intermediate state; it is furthermore a very quick method.  And this is the practice of sending your mind on purposely.

rows.acip: ,ZHES SOGS GSUNGS PA LTAR MI DGE BA SHIN TU GSOG TSABS CHE BA'I SDIG CAN (MI PHAL PA STONG DANG 'DRA,) YANG 'PHO BA BYAS PAS MKHA' SPYOD SOGS SNGAGS SGRUB PA'I RTEN KHYAD PAR CAN THOB PAR GSUNGS PA NYAMS LEN GNAD LA 'KHEL ZHING, 'PHO BA'I DUS ZIN NA PHAN YON SHIN TU CHE BAR GSUNGS,
rows.wylie: zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar mi dge ba shin tu gsog tshabs che ba'i sdig can (mi phal pa stong dang 'dra,) yang 'pho ba byas pas mkha' spyod sogs sngags sgrub pa'i rten khyad par can thob par gsungs pa nyams len gnad la 'khel zhing, 'pho ba'i dus zin na phan yon shin tu che bar gsungs
rows.english: The point here is that--even if you've been a particularly evil person, amassing piles of negative karma with bad deeds (such as the killing mentioned, which is like murdering a thousand regular people)--then still, it has been stated, you can attain a birth in a place such as the Angel's Heaven, and the extraordinary type of body and mind that you need to practice the way of the secret word, if you undertake the practice of sending your mind on purposely.  It is a way of focusing your practice at the most crucial points of all, and said to be of extremely great benefit should the circumstances demand such drastic action.

rows.acip: TSE NYAMS PA GSO BA TSE DBANG TSE SGRUB SOGS BYED PA, BSOD NAMS NYAMS PA GSO BA DKON MCHOG LA MCHOD PA, NGAN SLONG LA SBYIN GTONG, LAS NYAMS PA GSO BA STONG NYID SGOM PA DANG SROG BLU SOGS LA 'BAD CING, DES KYANG MA BZLOG NA NAD LA SOGS PA MA PHOG GONG DU 'PHO BAR BYA'O,,
rows.wylie: tshe nyams pa gso ba tshe dbang tshe sgrub sogs byed pa, bsod nams nyams pa gso ba dkon mchog la mchod pa, ngan slong la sbyin gtong, las nyams pa gso ba stong nyid sgom pa dang srog blu sogs la 'bad cing, des kyang ma bzlog na nad la sogs pa ma phog gong du 'pho bar bya'o
rows.english: In a case where your life force has declined and you seek to restore it, then you can do practices such as taking a long-life empowerment, or undertaking rituals which extend one's life.  Where your merit has declined, restore it by devoting yourself to practices such as making offerings to the Three Jewels, and making donations to the poor and needy.  If it's that your karma has declined, throw yourself into practices such as meditating on emptiness and rituals of ransoming to avert death.  If these don't work to stop the omens, then you should send your consciousness on before the sickness or whatever it will be strikes you and prevents you from doing so.

rows.acip: DBANG MTSAN NYID DANG LDAN PA LEGS PAR THOB NAS DAM SDOM MA NYAMS PA'AM NYAMS KYANG 'CHI KHA TSUN CHAD LA BSHAGS BSDOM LEGS PAR BYAS NA THA NA'ANG SKYE BA BCU DRUG TSUN LA NGES PAR RDO RJE RNAL 'BYOR MAS RJES SU BZUNG NAS SA LAM 'GROD NUS PA DANG,
rows.wylie: dbang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa legs par thob nas dam sdom ma nyams pa'am nyams kyang 'chi kha tshun chad la bshags bsdom legs par byas na tha na'ang skye ba bcu drug tshun la nges par rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung nas sa lam 'grod nus pa dang
rows.english: Now suppose that you have received properly an authentic empowerment into this practice; and that then you have kept your pledges and vows without breaking them--or even that you have broken them, but that at some point before you die you perform a proper confession where you openly admit your violations and seek to restrain yourself from repeating them in the future.  Within sixteen more lifetimes then at the very longest the Angel of Diamond will, without fail, come to you and lead you away, and you will be able to complete your journey through all the various levels and paths.

rows.acip: DE'I KHAR BSKYED RDZOGS KYI LAM TSUL BZHIN NYAMS SU BLANGS NA BAR DOR NGES PAR DPA' BO MKHA' 'GROS MKHA' SPYOD DU KHRID PAR 'GYUR RO,,

rows.acip: DBANG GI CHU BO MA NUB PA, BYIN RLABS KYI BRGYUD PA MA NYAMS PA, GDAMS DAG GI SA RGA MA LOG PA, MOS GUS KYIS BSAM PA TSIMS PA STE

rows.english: Any why is this the case?  First of all, these advices possess the four features of a true oral lineage:  the stream of the preliminary empowerment has not declined, the line of the blessing has not degenerated, the order of the topics of instruction has not been mixed up, and it functions to fulfill the hopes of those with faith and devotion.

rows.english: These advices secondly possess the four types of authority:  the authority of a qualified Lama, the authority of an authentic original teaching, the authority of classical commentaries on that teaching, and the authority of bringing about real-life experiences to those who practice them.

rows.acip: CHA LAG DANG BCAS PA PHYIN CI MA LOG PAR BRGYUD LDAN BLA MA DAM PA'I MAN NGAG LAS 'BYUNG BA LTAR TSUL BZHIN DU NYAMS SU BLANGS PA'I DGE BA'I RTZA BA 'DI'I MTHU LA BRTEN NAS ZHES BSNGO BYA'I DGE BA NGOS BZUNG BA'O,,
rows.wylie: cha lag dang bcas pa phyin ci ma log par brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthu la brten nas zhes bsngo bya'i dge ba ngos bzung ba'o
rows.english: Thus these advices are equipped with every necessary qualification, having been passed down correctly through a pure lineage, and their essence having been extracted and distilled from the personal instruction of those highest Lamas.  And those who have practiced the advices in accordance with this instruction, those who have practiced properly, can then pray that "By the power of this holy thing I've just done, may these amazing things now happen."  This is how we identify, with these few words, the virtue we wish to dedicate. And By This Power

rows.acip: GNYIS PA LAM DNGOS KYI RTOGS PA RGYUD LA SKYE BAR SMON PA LA GNYIS, GANG GIS NYAMS SU LEN PA'I RTEN GYI MTSAN NYID TSANG BAR SMON PA DANG, GANG ZHIG NYAMS SU BLANGS PAS LAM GYI RTOGS PA RGYUD LA SKYE BAR SMON PA'O,,
rows.wylie: gnyis pa lam dngos kyi rtogs pa rgyud la skye bar smon pa la gnyis, gang gis nyams su len pa'i rten gyi mtshan nyid tshang bar smon pa dang, gang zhig nyams su blangs pas lam gyi rtogs pa rgyud la skye bar smon pa'o
rows.english: Here is the second section, where we pray for realizations of the path itself to take birth in our minds.  It has two parts: praying for the complete conditions necessary to be able to practice--that is, a fully endowed human body and mind; and then praying for those things which, when we put them into practice, will cause realizations of the path to grow in our minds.

rows.acip: RANG GI LUS NGAG YID GSUM RJE BTZUN MA'I SKU GSUNG THUGS DANG PHYI NANG GSANG BA'I RNAL 'BYOR MAR NGO SPROD PAR BYED PA'I LUGS 'DI'I SINDHU RA'I DKYIL 'KHOR DU DBANG BZHI BYIN RLABS KYI TSUL DU BSKUR BA LEGS PAR THOB CING CHAG MED DU NYAMS SU LEN 'DOD KYI BDUD RTZI'I DPAL LA LONGS SPYAD PAS, GROL LAM BSKYED RDZOGS KYI LAM SGOM PA'I SNOD DU RUNG BAR SHOG CIG, CES SMON PA'O,,
rows.wylie: rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs dang phyi nang gsang ba'i rnal 'byor mar ngo sprod par byed pa'i lugs 'di'i sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba legs par thob cing chag med du nyams su len 'dod kyi bdud rtsi'i dpal la longs spyad pas, grol lam bskyed rdzogs kyi lam sgom pa'i snod du rung bar shog cig, ces smon pa'o
rows.english: After that, we are able to receive the blessing of the Angel of Diamond--the four full empowerments in the secret world of Sindhura.  In this initiation we have our first introduction to the outer, inner, and secret forms of the Diamond Queen, and our own body, speech and mind becomes the holy body, pure speech, and perfect mind of the holy Angel. If we wish to retain this blessing, and constantly bask in the glory of Her nectar, we must put this highest secret teaching we received into daily practice, without ever breaking it.  We are praying here that through the blessing of this pure initiation, we may become a worthy vessel to practice both the stage of creation and the stage of completion, which together become our path of liberation.

rows.acip: CES PA STE, DE YANG, RJE BDAG NYID CHEN POS, DE TSE DNGOS GRUB RNAM GNYIS 'GRUB PA'I GZHI, ,RNAM DAG DAM TSIG SDOM PAR GSUNGS PA LA, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR, DBANG THOB PA'I RJES SU LAM RIM PA GNYIS LA NYAMS LEN CHER MA BYUNG YANG, DAM SDOM SPYI DANG KHYAD PAR RTZA LTUNG GIS MA GOS NA NGAN SONG DU RDOG PAS PHUL YANG MI 'GRO ZHING MA THA SKYE BA BCU DRUG TSUN LA MCHOG GI DNGOS GRUB THOB PA YIN TE,

rows.english: Now as that highest Lord himself told us:  "It has been spoken that at this point (after receiving the empowerment) the cause of reaching both types of spiritual goals is keeping your pledges and vows pure."  And it is just as Je Tsongkapa has said.  Even if we find ourselves unable to put the path--the two stages--into practice very well, we still must keep all our pledges and vows, especially the root vows. If we do keep our vows, then even if we have done the best things we could do to send ourselves to one of the lower realms, we won't end up there.  The very worst that could happen is that within sixteen lives we reach the highest goal.  This is just as Master Vibhuti Chandra has stated:

rows.english: This last version can be found in the ritual for reaching the Angel written by my own Lord and Lama, who based it on descriptions of this practice found in the retreat manual of Changkya Rolpay Dorje.  In that manual, this version is described as easier to put into practice than the medium version, since there is no crystal palace. My Lama called this the extensive version of visualizing the refuge object. rows.english: Of course the enlightenment we seek can't be achieved without its causes and conditions, which in general are training ourselves in the activities of the sons and daughters of the Victorious Ones, and more specifically putting into practice the path that frees us--the path of the Diamond Queen. When we then think to ourselves: I will carry out in the proper way each step of Her path, both the stages of creation and completion--this is the Wish in the form of actions in our daily life.  And those two forms of the Wish--intention and actions--together are the actual deep practice of the limitless. Warrior of Diamond

rows.english: However, it doesn't seem to me that all three of these instructions were meant to be put into practice at that time.  If that were the case, then instead of putting into practice that which is carried out during the stage of completion--the practice called the shared inconceivable--we would be doing the practice known as the unique inconceivable, which is connected with the stage of creation, and used mainly for reaching outer heaven, like those practices such as Langali.  And to a mind as dull as mine, this wouldn't make much sense. _______________

rows.english: In our original condition, this state of mind is experienced directly at the hour of death, at the point when the winds dissolve into the central channel.  On the path, this state of mind is experienced directly through the power of our meditation, at the point when the winds dissolve into the central channel.  And for either of these, the essence of what we experience is something devoid of every extreme, devoid of any elaboration.  Just as in the direct perception of emptiness, the object which appears to this state of mind is sheer emptiness.

rows.wylie: nas lte ba'i phag mo ti la ka khams dmar po baM yig gi rnam pa can gyi nang gi rdo rje btsun mo'i mchog tsha ba me'i rang bzhin can de gyen du sbar bas spyi bo'i khams dkar po he ru ka'i ngo bor gnas pa zhu nas snying gar khams dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod byas pa'i rang zhal mthong ba ste nyams su myong ba'i rtse dgas rol par shog cig ces dang
rows.english: And so we are praying here that the "drop of the Sow"--the inner Angel, the red element in the form of a vam letter, that supreme queen of diamond, whose very nature is of heat and fire--is ignited, and flames up to the white element staying at the tip of the head, which is in essence Heruka. And we are praying thus that we come to laugh and play in this highest bliss of enjoying Her.

rows.acip: GONG GI PHYAG RGYA DE LA SA LUGS PA RNAMS NGO MTSAR SGYU MA'I PHYAG RGYA ZHES GSUNG BA, DZVA LA ZHES PA 'BAR BA, DRAL BA, SGO, NYA'I RGYA, SGYU MA SOGS DON MANG PO LA 'JUG PA LAS, SGYU MA LA BSGYUR NAS NGO MTSAR ZHES ZAB NYAMS SU MDZAD PA YIN KYANG, PHYAG RGYA 'DI ME 'BAR BA'I RNAM PAR YOD PAS 'BAR BA LA BSGYUR NA LEGS PAR RJE BDAG NYID CHEN POS GSUNGS SO,,
rows.wylie: gong gi phyag rgya de la sa lugs pa rnams ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya zhes gsung ba, dzva la zhes pa 'bar ba, dral ba, sgo, nya'i rgya, sgyu ma sogs don mang po la 'jug pa las, sgyu ma la bsgyur nas ngo mtshar zhes zab nyams su mdzad pa yin kyang, phyag rgya 'di me 'bar ba'i rnam par yod pas 'bar ba la bsgyur na legs par rje bdag nyid chen pos gsungs so
rows.english: Those in the Sakya system call the secret gesture mentioned above "the amazing gesture of illusion."  The Sanskrit word jvala has many meanings: "to blaze," "to split open," "a passageway," "a net for catching fish," and "an illusion," among many others.  On this point, our Lord the Great Being has stated that translating it as "an illusion" which is "amazing" is meant to lend it a profound sense, but it is good to translate it as "blazing" because this gesture has the appearance of a fire blazing. ...oooOOOooo...
