Reading: The Overview of the Middle-Way by Master Kedrup Tenpa Dargye Asian Classics Institute in Six Different Flavors The study of Mahamudra by westerners naturally involves two different questions: First, what is the meaning of this popular and mysterious word? Secondly, how do we practice it? We'll cover these questions in three steps, by calling on the first Panchen Lama for a description of the word; by studying the relationship between Mahamudra and the books on worldview; and finally exploring in depth the different Buddhist ideas of worldview. The First Panchen Lama, Lobsang Chukyi Gyeltsen (1565-1662), was one of the greatest masters of Tibetan Buddhism. He wrote over 250 separate books and essays, totalling more than 5,000 pages; the vast majority of these works are commentaries upon a wide variety of tantric practices. The following explanation of the "Great Seal," or Mahamudra, is taken from "A Lamp for Making Things Even More Clear," being an Expanded Explanation of the Root Text for the Great Seal (Mahamudra) according to the System of the Precious Tradition of the Virtuous Ones. This text is a detailed explanation of a shorter verse piece that he wrote on the same subject, entitled "The Highway of the Victorious Buddhas," being a Root Text on the Practice of the Great Seal (Mahamudra) in the Precious Tradition of the Teachings of the Virtuous Ones. These two works together are considered one of the best presentations of Mahamudra ever written.

rows.english: Lost in the sea of the cycle of pain, fear, shattered by waves of karma and their own negative thoughts, ripped at by the sharks of suffering, people of misery-- protect them please.
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS01", "acip": ",JIGS RUNG SRID PA'I RGYA MTSO 'DIR, ,LAS DANG NYON MONGS RBA KLONG 'KHRUG ,SDUG BSNGAL CHU SRIN GYIS GTZES PA'I, ,NYAM THAG 'GRO 'DI THUGS RJES SKYABS,", "wylie": "jigs rung srid pa'i rgya mtsho 'dir, ,las dang nyon mongs rba klong 'khrug ,sdug bsngal chu srin gyis gtses pa'i, ,nyam thag 'gro 'di thugs rjes skyabs", "english": "Lost in the sea of the cycle of pain, fear, shattered by waves of karma and their own negative thoughts, ripped at by the sharks of suffering, people of misery-- protect them please."}

rows.acip: ,DMYAL BA YI DVAGS DUD 'GRO SOGS, ,SDUG BSNGAL DRAG POS MNAR BA YI, ,MGON SKYABS MED PA'I 'GRO BA KUN, ,THUGS RJE MNGA' BAS BSKYAB TU GSOL,
rows.wylie: dmyal ba yi dvags dud 'gro sogs, ,sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba yi, ,mgon skyabs med pa'i 'gro ba kun, ,thugs rje mnga' bas bskyab tu gsol
rows.english: People in the realms of hell, starving spirits, animals, tortured, burned, no one to come to them-- but You do care; protect them, I beg You.
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS01", "acip": ",DMYAL BA YI DVAGS DUD 'GRO SOGS, ,SDUG BSNGAL DRAG POS MNAR BA YI, ,MGON SKYABS MED PA'I 'GRO BA KUN, ,THUGS RJE MNGA' BAS BSKYAB TU GSOL,", "wylie": "dmyal ba yi dvags dud 'gro sogs, ,sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba yi, ,mgon skyabs med pa'i 'gro ba kun, ,thugs rje mnga' bas bskyab tu gsol", "english": "People in the realms of hell, starving spirits, animals, tortured, burned, no one to come to them-- but You do care; protect them, I beg You."}

rows.acip: ,SKYE RGA NA 'CHI RGUD PA YI, ,'JIGS RUNG SRIN PO'I MCHE BA BZHI'I, ,PHRAG TU ZHUGS PA'I SKYE BO YI, ,MGON SKYABS MDZOD CIG ZAS GTZANG SRAS,
rows.wylie: skye rga na 'chi rgud pa yi, ,'jigs rung srin po'i mche ba bzhi'i, ,phrag tu zhugs pa'i skye bo yi, ,mgon skyabs mdzod cig zas gtsang sras
rows.english: All these people jammed between the fangs of the demons birth age sickness death sink their teeth into them-- but You do care; protect them, I beg You.

rows.acip: ,MTHA' DANG DBUS MED 'JIGS RUNG SKYI G-YA' BA'I, ,MI BZAD 'KHOR BA'I 'BROG DGON NYANG NGA BAR, ,SKYABS MED MGON MED LAN CIG MA YIN PAR, ,YANG YANG NYING MTSAMS SBYOR BA'ANG NYON MONGS DBANG ,
rows.wylie: mtha' dang dbus med 'jigs rung skyi g-ya' ba'i, ,mi bzad 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon nyang nga bar, ,skyabs med mgon med lan cig ma yin par, ,yang yang nying mtshams sbyor ba'ang nyon mongs dbang
rows.english: We stand on the desolate highland crag Of an unbearable cycle of suffering, Fear and terror where there is no beginning, And neither any end? Sadness simple without a shelter, With no one to protect us. And it was our very own negative thoughts That dropped us here from each death before, Not just this once alone.
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS02", "acip": ",MTHA' DANG DBUS MED 'JIGS RUNG SKYI G-YA' BA'I, ,MI BZAD 'KHOR BA'I 'BROG DGON NYANG NGA BAR, ,SKYABS MED MGON MED LAN CIG MA YIN PAR, ,YANG YANG NYING MTSAMS SBYOR BA'ANG NYON MONGS DBANG ,", "wylie": "mtha' dang dbus med 'jigs rung skyi g-ya' ba'i, ,mi bzad 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon nyang nga bar, ,skyabs med mgon med lan cig ma yin par, ,yang yang nying mtshams sbyor ba'ang nyon mongs dbang", "english": "We stand on the desolate highland crag Of an unbearable cycle of suffering, Fear and terror where there is no beginning, And neither any end? Sadness simple without a shelter, With no one to protect us. And it was our very own negative thoughts That dropped us here from each death before, Not just this once alone."}

rows.acip: MA RANG GI KHYER 'KHOS DANG BSTUN PA'I PHAN PA DANG BDE BA TSAD MED PA BSGRUBS, GNOD PA DANG SDUG BSNGAL TSAD MED PA LAS BSKYABS PAS DRIN SHIN TU CHE SNYAM DU BSAM,
rows.wylie: ma rang gi khyer 'khos dang bstun pa'i phan pa dang bde ba tshad med pa bsgrubs, gnod pa dang sdug bsngal tshad med pa las bskyabs pas drin shin tu che snyam du bsam
rows.english: In short, my mother did everything within her personal capacity to assure me limitless forms of help and happiness, and to protect me from limitless forms of suffering. Think thus how very kind your mother has been to you.
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS02", "acip": "MA RANG GI KHYER 'KHOS DANG BSTUN PA'I PHAN PA DANG BDE BA TSAD MED PA BSGRUBS, GNOD PA DANG SDUG BSNGAL TSAD MED PA LAS BSKYABS PAS DRIN SHIN TU CHE SNYAM DU BSAM,", "wylie": "ma rang gi khyer 'khos dang bstun pa'i phan pa dang bde ba tshad med pa bsgrubs, gnod pa dang sdug bsngal tshad med pa las bskyabs pas drin shin tu che snyam du bsam", "english": "In short, my mother did everything within her personal capacity to assure me limitless forms of help and happiness, and to protect me from limitless forms of suffering. Think thus how very kind your mother has been to you."}

rows.acip: MA NAM BYAS PA'I TSE, PHAN PA DANG BDE BA TSAD MED PA BSGRUBS, GNOD PA DANG SDUG BSNGAL TSAD MED PA LAS BSKYABS, KHYAD PAR BDAG GIS 'DI MED NA CUNG ZAD KYANG SDOD MI TSUGS PA DANG , 'DIS KYANG BDAG MED NA CUNG ZAD KYANG SDOD MI TSUGS PA LTA BU'I YID GCUGS PA BGRANG LAS 'DAS PA BYAS,
rows.wylie: ma nam byas pa'i tshe, phan pa dang bde ba tshad med pa bsgrubs, gnod pa dang sdug bsngal tshad med pa las bskyabs, khyad par bdag gis 'di med na cung zad kyang sdod mi tshugs pa dang , 'dis kyang bdag med na cung zad kyang sdod mi tshugs pa lta bu'i yid gcugs pa bgrang las 'das pa byas
rows.english: �And during each of those lives as my mother, they worked to acquire for me unlimited forms of help and happiness.  They protected me from unlimited forms of harm and suffering.  We were in a position where, without them, I simply never would have made it--and the same could be said for them without me.  We have counted on each other for lifetimes beyond number.

They protected me from unlimited forms of harm and suffering.  We were in a position where, without them, I simply never would have made it--and the same could be said for them without me.  We have counted on each other for lifetimes beyond number."}

rows.acip: ,DA DENG NAS BYANG CHUB SNYING PO'I BAR, ,MGON KHYOD ZHABS PAD+MO SPANGS NAS NI, ,BDAG RE BA'I SKYABS GZHAN MI 'TSOL BAS, ,PHA THUGS RJES ZUNGS SHIG AA TI SHA
rows.wylie: da deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar, ,mgon khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni, ,bdag re ba'i skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bas, ,pha thugs rjes zungs shig aa ti sha
rows.english: From this moment Until the day that I reach The heart of enlightenment I know I need never Leave, o Protector, Your lotus feet To go and seek Any other shelter. Come in mercy, take me with you, my Atisha.

rows.acip: ,BDAG NI MI SHES RMONGS PA YIS, ,DAM TSIG LAS NI 'GAL ZHING NYAMS, ,BLA MA MGON POS SKYABS MDZOD CIG
rows.wylie: bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis, ,dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams, ,bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig
rows.english: (After the last repetition of the mantra, say these words:) Out of my lack of understanding, From sheer stupidity, I have acted against my commitments, And broken them. You are my Lamas, You are my Protectors; And I ask You To save me now.

rows.acip: ,DE NYID THUGS RJE CHEN POS RAB KHROS PAS, ,SGYU MA'I SRIN PO SRID GSUM ZA BA BZHIN, ,DAM NYAMS PHYI NANG 'CHI BDAG GSHIN RJE'I DGRA, ,BLA MA YI DAM DBYER MED SKYABS BZUNG NAS,
rows.wylie: de nyid thugs rje chen pos rab khros pas, ,sgyu ma'i srin po srid gsum za ba bzhin, ,dam nyams phyi nang 'chi bdag gshin rje'i dgra, ,bla ma yi dam dbyer med skyabs bzung nas
rows.english: The boundless compassion of Your heart Now rages in fury; You're a warlock of illusion Prepared to swallow All three realms of the universe: Now You are The foe of the Slayer, The enemy of the Lord of Death, The death outside and in as well, The death of pledges broken. Protect us, keep us, Lama and Close Angel, Indivisible.

rows.acip: SH'AN+TI PAS, DNGOS MED CHOS ZHES BYA BA NI SHES RAB KYI PHA ROL TU PHYIN PA STE DE LA NAM YANG MI SMAD DE, THOS NAS BLO CHUNG DE YIS 'DI NI SPONG BYED DE, ,SPANGS NAS SKYABS MED GYUR PA DE NI MNAR MED 'GRO, ZHES GSUNGS PAS SO,
rows.wylie: shAn+ti pas, dngos med chos zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste de la nam yang mi smad de, thos nas blo chung de yis 'di ni spong byed de, ,spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro, zhes gsungs pas so
rows.english: Shantipa says the following: The wording here speaks of "that which is no thing."  What this is referring to is the perfection of wisdom; and what it is saying is that we must never disparage this perfection: Any person of deficient intellect Who rejects this very thing Will lose whatever protection they had, And pass to the lowest of hells. ***

rows.acip: BZHI PA TSAD MED KYI RNAL 'BYOR NI, LUS GNAD DANG LDAN PAR 'KHOD NAS, MDUN GYI NAM MKHAR BLA MA 'KHOR LO SDOM PA YAB YUM LA RTZA BRGYUD KYI BLA MA YI DAM MCHOG GSUM BKA' SDOD SRUNG MA'I TSOGS KYIS BSKOR NAS BZHUGS PA LA, RANG DANG SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYIS SKYABS SU 'GRO BAR MOS NAS,
rows.wylie: bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor ni, lus gnad dang ldan par 'khod nas, mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam mchog gsum bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la, rang dang sems can thams cad kyis skyabs su 'gro bar mos nas
rows.english: (Put yourself into the correct meditation posture, and see the following:) In the air in front of me Are seated the Lama, The Union of Spheres, man and woman, Surrounded by an assembly Of my root and lineage Lamas, Close Angels and the Three Supreme, The Protectors of the Word.

rows.acip: DE THAMS CAD KYI GNAS GSUM RDO RJE GSUM GYIS MTSAN PA'I H'Um YIG GI 'OD ZER GYIS BLA MA YI DAM SANGS RGYAS BYANG SEMS DPA' BO MKHA' 'GRO CHOS SKYONG SRUNG MA'I TSOGS RNAMS SPYAN DRANGS TE THIM PAS THAMS CAD KYANG SKYABS GNAS KUN 'DUS KYI NGO BOR GYUR PAR BSAM LA,
rows.wylie: de thams cad kyi gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyis mtshan pa'i hUM yig gi 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs te thim pas thams cad kyang skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam la
rows.english: Each of the Lamas Is marked at the three places Upon their body With the three diamonds. From the letter hung Fly forth rays of light, Which travel to the Lamas, The Close Angels and the Buddhas, The bodhisattvas, Warriors and their Ladies, Keepers and Protectors Of the Holy Dharma To masses of these Holy Beings. The light invites Them forth; They come and melt Into the assembled Lamas. Each one of Them becomes Every form of shelter there is.

rows.acip: ,BDE STONG LHAN CIG SKYES PA'I YE SHES KYI, ,GZUNG RNAM PHUNG KHAMS SKYE MCHED LAS BYUNG BA'I, ,RI GLING RIN CHEN GTER BUM NYI ZLAR BCAS, ,SKYABS MGON THUGS RJE'I GTER LA 'BUL BAR BGYI,
rows.wylie: bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi, ,gzung rnam phung khams skye mched las byung ba'i, ,ri gling rin chen gter bum nyi zlar bcas, ,skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter la 'bul bar bgyi
rows.english: Here is a world Of mountains and continents, The precious ones And the goldmine vase, The sun and moon as well, All of them come From the heaps and parts And gateways that are me, Held by the mind of wisdom: Simultaneous bliss and emptiness. I offer this world to You, My Savior and Protector, Treasure of Compassion.

rows.acip: ,BDAG GZHAN 'GRO BA'I SKYABS MGON RGYAL BA MCHOG ,BDAG NYID CHEN PO 'JAM DBYANGS NAM MKHA'I MTSAN, ,BDAG CHEN CHOS RJE BLO GROS RGYAL MTSAN ZHABS, ,GSOL BA 'DEBS SO LHAN SKYES YE SHES STZOL,
rows.wylie: bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal ba mchog ,bdag nyid chen po 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan, ,bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs, ,gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol
rows.english: I make supplication At the feet Of Gyalwa Chok, Savior and protector Of me and other beings; At the feet Of Namkay Tsen, The Soft Voice, The Great Being; And at the feet Of Lodru Gyeltsen, Lord of the Dharma, The Great Being; Grant me simultaneous wisdom.

rows.acip: BTZUN MO DRI MED SGRON MAS CHOS KYIS GROGS MDZAD, SKYES MCHOG NAM MKHA'I SNYING POS SPANGS NAS, NYER LNGA LA GNAS BZHI DGA' BA'I 'TSAL DU 'PHEBS, MKHAN PO SANGS RGYAS SKYABS DANG , SLOB DPON YE SHES 'OD LA DGE TSUL GYI SDOM PA BZHES NA, MTSAN SANGS RGYAS YES SU GSOL CING LO GSUM BZHUGS, 'DUL BA LUNG BZHI, RGYA CHE ROL PA, LAS RGYA PA, DRAN PA NYER BZHAG, SKYE RABS, MDO RTZA RNAMS GSAN CING THUGS SU CHUD PAR MDZAD,
rows.wylie: btsun mo dri med sgron mas chos kyis grogs mdzad, skyes mchog nam mkha'i snying pos spangs nas, nyer lnga la gnas bzhi dga' ba'i 'tshal du 'phebs, mkhan po sangs rgyas skyabs dang , slob dpon ye shes 'od la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes na, mtshan sangs rgyas yes su gsol cing lo gsum bzhugs, 'dul ba lung bzhi, rgya che rol pa, las rgya pa, dran pa nyer bzhag, skye rabs, mdo rtsa rnams gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad
rows.english: And so--with Queen Immaculate continually serving as his spiritual companion--our highest of beings, Heart of the Sky, quits the palace.  Now twenty-five years old, He journeys to a place called Pleasure Gardens of the God of the Four Places.  Here he takes His vows as a novice monk, with the monk named Protecting Buddha serving as his vowmaster, and Light of Wisdom acting as the presiding member of the community.  He is granted the name Wisdom of the Buddhas, and remains here for the next three years. During this time, Master Naropa studied the Four Core Works of Monastic Discipline; the Sutra of the Cosmic Game; the Hundred Deeds; the Sutra of Close Recollection; the Accounts of the Past Lives of the Buddhas; and the Root Sutra on Discipline.  And He grasped them all, completely.

rows.acip: DE LTAR NA DA RES RANG DBANG RANG LA YOD SKABS 'DIR MA MTHA' NGA PHYI MAR NGAN SONG GI SKYE SGO GCOD THUB PA ZHIG NGES PAR BYED DGOS, DE LA NGAN SONG GI 'JIGS PA LAS SKYOB PA'I SKYABS 'TSOL, NGAN SONG GI SDUG BSNGAL LAS THAR BA'I THABS LA 'BAD DGOS,
rows.wylie: de ltar na da res rang dbang rang la yod skabs 'dir ma mtha' nga phyi mar ngan song gi skye sgo gcod thub pa zhig nges par byed dgos, de la ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i skyabs 'tshol, ngan song gi sdug bsngal las thar ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos
rows.english: And so this time, now, while we still have some influence over the situation, we must definitely try at least to see if we can shut the door that leads to the lower realms for our next life.  To succeed at this we must be afraid of the lower realms, and this fear must drive us to seek some refuge which can protect us from these births.  We must try to seek some method to free ourselves from the sufferings of the lower realms, and then we must follow that method.

rows.wylie: dngul chu bar mtshan lam du dpe cha phul tshul, bdag gis rje dngul chu ba blo bzang 'jigs med dbang po dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas 'di'i skor cha tshang pa dang, gzhan yang tre bo khang gsar skyabs mgon blo bzang tshul khrims bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las kyang thob cing
rows.english: Our Lama then related to us how Ngulchu had been granted a scripture on the practice in a dream.  I myself, He said, have received the empowerment, oral transmission, explanation, and private advices of this practice in the proper way, as follows.  I have received the complete instruction on this subject from the holy lips of the good and glorious Lord, Lobsang Jigme Wangpo, of the Ngulchu tradition.  I have also received it from the Savior and Protector from Trehor Kangtsen, the good and glorious Lobsang Tsultrim Tepay Gyeltsen.

rows.acip: RANG GZHAN SEMS CAN THAMS CAD 'KHOR BA DANG NGAN SONG GI SDUG BSNGAL LA 'JIGS SHING SKRAG PA'I NGES 'BYUNG DANG SNYING RJE'I BLO BSKYED PA RGYU GCIG, MDUN GYI SKYABS YUL RNAMS LA DE LAS SKYOB PA'I MKHYEN BRTZE NUS GSUM YOD PAR YID CHES PA RGYU GCIG STE SKYABS 'GRO'I RGYU GNYIS SU BZHED PA DANG,
rows.wylie: rang gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs shing skrag pa'i nges 'byung dang snying rje'i blo bskyed pa rgyu gcig, mdun gyi skyabs yul rnams la de las skyob pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum yod par yid ches pa rgyu gcig ste skyabs 'gro'i rgyu gnyis su bzhed pa dang
rows.english: Now it is said that there are two different incentives for seeking spiritual shelter.  The first of them leads to two different states of mind--to both feelings of dismay with this life, and to compassion.  And that is a sense of fear, of terror, for the way that I and every other living being must continue with this suffering of the cycle of life, and of the three lower realms. The second of the incentives is a belief that the places of shelter here before me possess three qualities that can protect me from these things: They possess high knowledge; love; and power.

rows.acip: RANG GI SDUG BSNGAL DRAN NAS NGES 'BYUNG DANG, GZHAN GYI SDUG BSNGAL DRAN NAS SNYING RJE BSKYED PA, SKYABS YUL RNAMS LA 'JIGS PA DE LAS SKYOB PA'I NUS PA YOD PAR SHES PA STE THEG CHEN LA RGYU GSUM DU BZHED DO,
rows.wylie: rang gi sdug bsngal dran nas nges 'byung dang, gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dran nas snying rje bskyed pa, skyabs yul rnams la 'jigs pa de las skyob pa'i nus pa yod par shes pa ste theg chen la rgyu gsum du bzhed do
rows.english: In the greater way, these incentives are counted as three.  The first is the feeling of dismay that we get when we think of all our own suffering.  The second is the compassion we feel when we think of the way that others are suffering.  And the third is the knowledge that the places of refuge do possess the power to protect us all from these terrors.

rows.acip: DE NAS LUS GNAD DANG LDAN PAR 'KHOD NAS, MDUN GYI NAM MKHAR SOGS TSAR GCIG BRJOD, BLA MAS SKYABS DNGOS SU STON PA, SANGS RGYAS KYIS BRGYUD NAS STON PA, CHOS SKYABS DNGOS TE, DE NYID RANG GIS NYAMS SU BLANGS PAS SKYOB NUS SHING, DGE 'DUN RNAMS KYIS JI LTAR LAM LA SLOB PA LTAR BDAG GIS KYANG SLOB SNYAM PA'I GROGS ZHUS,
rows.wylie: de nas lus gnad dang ldan par 'khod nas, mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs tshar gcig brjod, bla mas skyabs dngos su ston pa, sangs rgyas kyis brgyud nas ston pa, chos skyabs dngos te, de nyid rang gis nyams su blangs pas skyob nus shing, dge 'dun rnams kyis ji ltar lam la slob pa ltar bdag gis kyang slob snyam pa'i grogs zhus
rows.english: Next you should assume the posture for meditation, and recite the line which begins with "In the air in front of me."  [The full line reads: "In the air in front of me are seated the Lama, the Union of Spheres, man and woman, surrounded by an assembly of my root and lineage Lamas, Close Angels and the Three Supreme, the Protectors of the Word."] Our Lama directly teaches us how to find protection; the Buddha teaches us this same thing indirectly.  The real shelter though is the Dharma, because it is the one thing which--if we actually put it into practice--is able to protect us.  The Community of those who are realized provide us with assistance: we think to ourselves, "I will train myself in the path, just as they have already managed to do."
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS09", "acip": "DE NAS LUS GNAD DANG LDAN PAR 'KHOD NAS, MDUN GYI NAM MKHAR SOGS TSAR GCIG BRJOD, BLA MAS SKYABS DNGOS SU STON PA, SANGS RGYAS KYIS BRGYUD NAS STON PA, CHOS SKYABS DNGOS TE, DE NYID RANG GIS NYAMS SU BLANGS PAS SKYOB NUS SHING, DGE 'DUN RNAMS KYIS JI LTAR LAM LA SLOB PA LTAR BDAG GIS KYANG SLOB SNYAM PA'I GROGS ZHUS,", "wylie": "de nas lus gnad dang ldan par 'khod nas, mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs tshar gcig brjod, bla mas skyabs dngos su ston pa, sangs rgyas kyis brgyud nas ston pa, chos skyabs dngos te, de nyid rang gis nyams su blangs pas skyob nus shing, dge 'dun rnams kyis ji ltar lam la slob pa ltar bdag gis kyang slob snyam pa'i grogs zhus", "english": "Next you should assume the posture for meditation, and recite the line which begins with \"In the air in front of me.\"  [The full line reads: \"In the air in front of me are seated the Lama, the Union of Spheres, man and woman, surrounded by an assembly of my root and lineage Lamas, Close Angels and the Three Supreme, the Protectors of the Word.\"] Our Lama directly teaches us how to find protection; the Buddha teaches us this same thing indirectly. rows.acip: SANGS RGYAS CHOS GSUNG BA PO DNGOS DANG, DE NAS RIM GYIS BRGYUD PA'I BLA MA RNAMS KYIS STON PAS, DBUS KYI 'KHOR LO SDOM PA YAB YUM DANG RTZA BRGYUD KYI BLA MA RNAMS LA SKYABS STON PA PO MDZAD DU GSOL SNYAM PA'M SA LUGS PA LAM SNA 'DREN PA'I SKYABS MDZAD DU GSOL SNYAM DU, DPAL LDAN BLA MA ZHES SOGS BRJOD CING DE YANG BLA MA DAM PA NI SLOB MA'I NGAN SPYOD KYI RIGS LA KHRO NA DAM PA DANG RANG DON DU KHRO NA DAM PA MA YIN NO,
rows.wylie: sangs rgyas chos gsung ba po dngos dang, de nas rim gyis brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis ston pas, dbus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum dang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la skyabs ston pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pa'm sa lugs pa lam sna 'dren pa'i skyabs mdzad du gsol snyam du, dpal ldan bla ma zhes sogs brjod cing de yang bla ma dam pa ni slob ma'i ngan spyod kyi rigs la khro na dam pa dang rang don du khro na dam pa ma yin no
rows.english: Lord Buddha was the one who actually spoke the Dharma, and then it was taught, generation after generation, by the Lamas of the lineage.  Therefore, as you recite the lines that contain "holy Lamas of glory," think that you are asking the central figure of Union of Spheres, Man and Wife--along with all of your root and lineage Lamas--to please teach you about refuge.  Or, as in the Sakya tradition, you can think that you are asking Them to please protect you by guiding you in the path. The meaning of the expression "holy Lama" is as follows.  If you get angry at one of your students because they are doing something wrong, then you are holy.  But if you just get angry for its own sake, then you are not holy.

rows.acip: MDUN DANG GA-YAS KYI SANGS RGYAS RNAMS KYIS SKYABS STON PA MDZAD DU GSOL SNYAM DU RDZOGS PA'I ZHES SOGS BRJOD, RGYAB DANG SKYABS YUL RNAMS KYI THUGS RGYUD LA MNGA' BA'I RTOGS PA'I CHOS RNAMS KYIS SKYABS DNGOS MDZAD DU GSOL SNYAM DU DAM PA'I ZHES SOGS BRJOD, GA-YON DANG MTHA' SKOR DU BZHUGS PA'I DGE 'DUN DKON MCHOG RNAMS KYIS SKYABS SGRUB PA'I GROGS MDZAD DU GSOL SNYAM DU, 'PHAGS PA'I ZHES SOGS BRJOD,
rows.wylie: mdun dang ga-yas kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis skyabs ston pa mdzad du gsol snyam du rdzogs pa'i zhes sogs brjod, rgyab dang skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs rgyud la mnga' ba'i rtogs pa'i chos rnams kyis skyabs dngos mdzad du gsol snyam du dam pa'i zhes sogs brjod, ga-yon dang mtha' skor du bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams kyis skyabs sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol snyam du, 'phags pa'i zhes sogs brjod
rows.english: As you recite the lines that include the word "full" enlightenment, think that you are asking the Buddhas on the front petal, and on the one to your Lama's right, to please teach you about protection. As you recite the lines that include "holy" Dharma, think that you are asking for actual protection from the books on the back petal, as well as from the Dharma realizations in the hearts of all the places of refuge. And when you recite the lines that include "persons who are realized," think that you are asking the Jewel of the Community on the left petal, as well as all the other Community surrounding the flower, to please assist you in your search for protection.

rows.acip: DE NAS SKYABS GSOL BRJOD PAR BYA STE LAG GNYIS SNYING GAR THAL MO SBYAR NAS BLA MA DANG DKON MCHOG+ SKYABS YUL RNAMS LAS 'OD ZER SNA LNGA DPAG MED BYUNG BA RANG GZHAN GYI LUS SEMS LA THIM PAS SDIG SGRIB THAMS CAD MUN KHUNG DU SGRON ME'AM NYI ZER ZHUGS PA BZHIN SKAD CIG LA DAG STE, SEMS RTOG MED CHOS SKU DANG, LUS LONGS SKU RNAL 'BYOR MAR GYUR TE,
rows.wylie: de nas skyabs gsol brjod par bya ste lag gnyis snying gar thal mo sbyar nas bla ma dang dkon mchog+ skyabs yul rnams las 'od zer sna lnga dpag med byung ba rang gzhan gyi lus sems la thim pas sdig sgrib thams cad mun khung du sgron me'am nyi zer zhugs pa bzhin skad cig la dag ste, sems rtog med chos sku dang, lus longs sku rnal 'byor mar gyur te
rows.english: Now you should request protection.  Join your palms at your breast, and repeat the lines that begin with "I bow down and I go for refuge."  An inconceivable number of light rays, in five different colors, burst forth from the places of refuge, and sink into both the bodies and minds of myself and all the others here with me.  They banish all our negative deeds and obstacles in a single instant, like the light of a lamp, or that of the sun, suddenly released into a dark room. Our minds transform into the body of the dharma, beyond all conceptual thought, and our bodies transform into the body of enjoyment: the Angel herself.

rows.acip: SKYABS 'GRO RNAM DAG NI, RANG NYID 'KHOR BA DANG NGAN SONG GI 'JIGS PA MTHA' DAG LAS SKYOB NUS PA SU 'DUG BRTAGS PA NA, NANG PA SANGS RGYAS PA'I SANGS RGYAS, CHOS, DGE 'DUN GSUM PO KHO NA MA GTOGS GZHAN SUS KYANG SKYOB PAR MI NUS PAR SHES PA'I YID CHES KYI DAD PA LA BYA,
rows.wylie: skyabs 'gro rnam dag ni, rang nyid 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa mtha' dag las skyob nus pa su 'dug brtags pa na, nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas, chos, dge 'dun gsum po kho na ma gtogs gzhan sus kyang skyob par mi nus par shes pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa la bya
rows.english: The true attitude of taking refuge begins with looking around to see who there is that has the power to protect you yourself from all the terrors of cyclic life and the lower realms.  Then you find what we call the "faith of intelligent belief," which means that you come to realize that no one at all has this power except for the Three of the Buddhist faith: the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Community.  All this is what it takes for true refuge.

rows.acip: NANG PA SANGS RGYAS PA LAS LOGS SU GYUR PA'I STON PA DANG BSTAN PA GANG GIS KYANG GDUL BYA LAM LOG PA LAS SKYOB MI NUS TE, SANGS RGYAS KYI BSTAN PA NI LAM DANG, GZHAN GYI BSTAN PA NI LAM MA YIN PA DANG, SANGS RGYAS KYI BSTAN PA NI 'KHOR BA LAS LDOG BYED DANG, GZHAN GYI BSTAN PA NI 'KHOR BAR 'JUG BYED YIN PA SOGS LHA LAS PHUL BYUNG GI BSTOD PA LAS GSUNGS PA LAM RIM CHEN MO LAS 'BYUNG BA LTAR YIN PAS SKYABS YUL GYI NGO BO NGOS 'DZIN SOGS SHES PA SHIN TU GAL CHE,
rows.wylie: nang pa sangs rgyas pa las logs su gyur pa'i ston pa dang bstan pa gang gis kyang gdul bya lam log pa las skyob mi nus te, sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni lam dang, gzhan gyi bstan pa ni lam ma yin pa dang, sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni 'khor ba las ldog byed dang, gzhan gyi bstan pa ni 'khor bar 'jug byed yin pa sogs lha las phul byung gi bstod pa las gsungs pa lam rim chen mo las 'byung ba ltar yin pas skyabs yul gyi ngo bo ngos 'dzin sogs shes pa shin tu gal che
rows.english: Apart from the Buddha and Buddhism, no teacher or teaching that exists has the power to protect disciples from a mistaken path.  The Teaching of the Buddha is the path, and other teachings are the opposite of a path.  The Teaching of the Buddha turns you back from this suffering life, and other teachings send you into it. These and other truths are described in a eulogy entitled More Excellent than the Gods, as it is appears in the Greater Steps of the Path to Buddhahood.  Therefore it is extremely important to learn all the various points like identifying just what it is that makes someone or something an object of refuge.

rows.acip: NAD PA NAD LAS THAR PA LA SMAN PA DANG, SMAN DANG, NAD GA YOG GSUM GA BSTEN DGOS PA BZHIN DU RANG NYID 'KHOR BA DANG NGAN SONG GI 'JIGS PA MTHA' DAG LAS THAR BA LA 'KHOR BA DANG NGAN SONG GI SDUG BSNGAL LA YID 'JIGS PA DANG, DE LAS SKYOB PA'I NUS PA DKON MCHOG LA YOD PAR YID CHES TE DKON MCHOG LA BLO LINGS KYIS 'GEL BA'I SGO NAS SNYING THAG PA NAS SKYABS 'GRO BYED DGOS, SKYABS 'GRO'I RGYU YANG 'JIGS PA DANG DAD PA 'DI GNYIS YIN,
rows.wylie: nad pa nad las thar pa la sman pa dang, sman dang, nad ga yog gsum ga bsten dgos pa bzhin du rang nyid 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa mtha' dag las thar ba la 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la yid 'jigs pa dang, de las skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog la yod par yid ches te dkon mchog la blo lings kyis 'gel ba'i sgo nas snying thag pa nas skyabs 'gro byed dgos, skyabs 'gro'i rgyu yang 'jigs pa dang dad pa 'di gnyis yin
rows.english: If a patient wants to get free of his illness they have to rely on their physician, their medicine, and their nurses.  I am the same the way; to get free of all the terrors of the cycle of life and the lower realms, I must first be afraid of the sufferings of the cycle of life and the lower realms. And then I must have intelligent belief that the Three Jewels have the power to protect me from these sufferings; I must have total and complete trust in the Three Jewels.  All this is refuge, and I must take it from the bottom of my heart.  And the reasons for us to take refuge are precisely these two: fear and faith.

rows.acip: RANG SRID ZHI'I SDUG BSNGAL LA 'JIGS SHING SKRAG PA'I NGES 'BYUNG DANG, GZHAN SRID ZHI'I SDUG BSNGAL GYIS MNAR BA LA MI BZOD PA'I SNYING RJE DANG, RANG GZHAN SRID ZHI'I 'JIGS PA LAS SKYOB PA'I SKYABS BSLU BA MED PA DKON MCHOG GSUM YIN PAR YID CHES PA'I THEG CHEN THUN MONG MIN PA'I SKYABS 'GRO'I RGYU GSUM GSAL BTAB STE,
rows.wylie: rang srid zhi'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs shing skrag pa'i nges 'byung dang, gzhan srid zhi'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la mi bzod pa'i snying rje dang, rang gzhan srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i skyabs bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum yin par yid ches pa'i theg chen thun mong min pa'i skyabs 'gro'i rgyu gsum gsal btab ste
rows.english: Now bring to mind the three reasons for taking the very unique refuge of the greater way.  The first is renunciation, where you feel deep fear, terror, about the sufferings you yourself will have to undergo in the cycle of life, or in a lower nirvana. Second is compassion, where you can no longer bear how others are tormented by these same sufferings, of cyclic life and lower nirvana.  And third is the intelligent belief that the only refuge that can never fail us, the one refuge that can protect you and others from all these fears of the circle of life and lower nirvana, is the Three Jewels.

rows.acip: RANG GZHAN LA SKYABS YUL 'DI RNAMS YOD PAS NA 'KHOR BA DANG NGAN SONG GI 'JIGS PA MTHA' DAG LAS SKYOB NGES PAS DA RES SKYABS SU 'GRO BAR BYA'O SNYAM PA'I SGO NAS SKYABS 'GRO BYA,

rows.english: And so take your refuge, thinking to yourself: "Now I go for refuge, because these places of refuge for myself and others do exist, and because it is certain that They will protect us from each and every fear of cyclic life and the lower realms."
rows.raw: {"course": "TCS09", "acip": "RANG GZHAN LA SKYABS YUL 'DI RNAMS YOD PAS NA 'KHOR BA DANG NGAN SONG GI 'JIGS PA MTHA' DAG LAS SKYOB NGES PAS DA RES SKYABS SU 'GRO BAR BYA'O SNYAM PA'I SGO NAS SKYABS 'GRO BYA,", "wylie": "rang gzhan la skyabs yul 'di rnams yod pas na 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa mtha' dag las skyob nges pas da res skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro bya", "english": "And so take your refuge, thinking to yourself: \"Now I go for refuge, because these places of refuge for myself and others do exist, and because it is certain that They will protect us from each and every fear of cyclic life and the lower realms.\""}

rows.acip: KHA NAS BRAG PHUG CES MA BRJOD KYANG RANG PHUG PA'I NANG DU PHAR ZHUGS NA GDUNG BA DE DAG LAS NGES PAR SKYOB NUS PA BZHIN SKYABS 'GRO KHA NAS GRANGS KA MA BSAGS KYANG DKON MCHOG LA BLO LINGS 'GEL BYUNG NA SKYABS 'GRO RNAM DAG YIN PAS 'JIGS PA LAS SKYOB PAR NGES,
rows.wylie: kha nas brag phug ces ma brjod kyang rang phug pa'i nang du phar zhugs na gdung ba de dag las nges par skyob nus pa bzhin skyabs 'gro kha nas grangs ka ma bsags kyang dkon mchog la blo lings 'gel byung na skyabs 'gro rnam dag yin pas 'jigs pa las skyob par nges
rows.english: But suppose he just forgets about saying the words "Cave! Cave!"  Suppose he just goes and steps into a real cave.  It can surely protect him from his pains. With us it's the same.  We may not be able to recite refuge prayers from our mouths over and over and accumulate them up, but it is true refuge if we manage to find absolute trust in the Three Jewels, and it will definitely protect us from our fears.

rows.acip: DA DUNG 'DI'I STENG DU BLA MCHOD KYI, SKYABS MGON RJE BTZUN BLA MA 'KHOR BCAS LA, ,ZHES SOGS NAS, NAM MKHA' JI SRID 'BANGS SU GZUNG DU GSOL, ZHES LUS BRAN DU 'BUL BA'I BAR BYA THUB KYANG MCHOG TU 'GYUR GSUNGS,
rows.wylie: da dung 'di'i steng du bla mchod kyi, skyabs mgon rje btsun bla ma 'khor bcas la, ,zhes sogs nas, nam mkha' ji srid 'bangs su gzung du gsol, zhes lus bran du 'bul ba'i bar bya thub kyang mchog tu 'gyur gsungs
rows.english: If you can go further and recite this entire section from the Offering to Lamas, said our Lama, it's better than anything.  This would be the lines starting from "To my Savior and Protector, the Holy Lama, together with Their retinue," and continuing up to where you see yourself as a servant and offer your body, ending with the words "I ask You to keep me as your subject, for as long as the sky shall last."

rows.acip: DE NAS MCHOD PA THAMS CAD KYI MCHOG SGRUB PA'I MCHOD PA 'BUL BA NI, DKON MCHOG GSUM LA BDAG SKYABS MCHI, ,ZHES SOGS TE, RANG SRID ZHI'I 'JIGS PAS MNAR BA LA MI BZOD PA'I NGES 'BYUNG, GZHAN DE LTAR MNAR BA LA MI BZOD PA'I SNYING RJE, 'JIGS BDE LAS SKYOB PA'I SKYABS BSLU BA MED PA MDUN GYI TSOGS ZHING RNAMS YIN SNYAM PA'I YID CHES KYIS BLO LINGS 'GEL BYED PA THEG CHEN THUN MONG MIN PA'I SKYABS 'GRO BYA,
rows.wylie: de nas mchod pa thams cad kyi mchog sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni, dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi, ,zhes sogs te, rang srid zhi'i 'jigs pas mnar ba la mi bzod pa'i nges 'byung, gzhan de ltar mnar ba la mi bzod pa'i snying rje, 'jigs bde las skyob pa'i skyabs bslu ba med pa mdun gyi tshogs zhing rnams yin snyam pa'i yid ches kyis blo lings 'gel byed pa theg chen thun mong min pa'i skyabs 'gro bya
rows.english: Next we offer the highest of all offerings, which is the offering of our own practice.  This begins with the words, "I go for refuge to the Three Jewels."  Here we take refuge, in the way which is unique to the greater way.  This first includes renunciation, where we can no longer bear the way we ourselves are tortured by the various terrors of the circle of life and lower peace.  Second is compassion, where we can no longer bear the way other beings are tortured by the same things.  And finally there is the state of mind where we put our complete and total trust in the Beings before us, the Beings with whom we hope to amass virtue; we have the intelligent belief that They are a shelter which can protect us from these fears; They are a refuge which can never fail.

rows.acip: 'DI NYID SKYABS MGON DAM PA THUGS RJE DANG BKA' DRIN TSE RABS THAMS CAD DU GZHAL BAR DKA' BA'I RDO RJE CAN GYI BLA MA KHYED LA SNYING THAG PA NAS 'BUL BA STE DBUL BAR BGYI, ZHES SNGAGS LUGS LA 'BREL SHIN TU CHE, ZHES PA 'DI LTA BU'I NYAMS LEN GYI SDOMS NI, TSIG NYUNG DON RGYAS MKHAS PA MGU BA BSKYED PA'I GNAS SAM SNYAM, DE NAS BRGYUD 'DEBS NGAG 'DON LTAR BYAS NAS GSOL BA SHUGS DRAG BTAB LA,
rows.wylie: 'di nyid skyabs mgon dam pa thugs rje dang bka' drin tshe rabs thams cad du gzhal bar dka' ba'i rdo rje can gyi bla ma khyed la snying thag pa nas 'bul ba ste dbul bar bgyi, zhes sngags lugs la 'brel shin tu che, zhes pa 'di lta bu'i nyams len gyi sdoms ni, tshig nyung don rgyas mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa'i gnas sam snyam, de nas brgyud 'debs ngag 'don ltar byas nas gsol ba shugs drag btab la
rows.english: From the bottom of your heart offer this mandala most especially to your Lama: "to You," to the one who holds the diamond, to your Savior and Protector, whose kindness and compassion over all of your lives is so difficult to even measure. Performing the mandala offering in these words has a deep connection with the way of the Secret Word.  It seems to me that the summary of all Buddhist practice contained in these lines--few in words yet vast in meaning--is something that would bring great pleasure to the wise.  Then make fierce supplications, as you recite the words of request to the lineage Lamas. The Blessing of the Four Empowerments

rows.acip: RKANG BRGYAD KYI RKANG PA RE RE'I MTHAD d'A DRIL LAN GNYIS RE LAS MDZAD SROL MED KYANG, BDAG GI SKYABS MCHOG DVAGS PO BLA MA RIN PO CHE'I PHYAG BZHES LTAR H'Um H'Um PHAt GSUM LA d'A DRIL LAN GSUM RE BRDEB DGOS,
rows.wylie: rkang brgyad kyi rkang pa re re'i mthad DA dril lan gnyis re las mdzad srol med kyang, bdag gi skyabs mchog dvags po bla ma rin po che'i phyag bzhes ltar hUM hUM phaT gsum la DA dril lan gsum re brdeb dgos
rows.english: There is no tradition of playing the damaru drum and the bell any more than two times at the end of each of the lines.  Nonetheless you should follow the custom of my Supreme Protector, Dakpo Lama Rinpoche, and play the damaru and bell three times, once for each of the three syllables of hung, hung, phet.

rows.acip: MKHA' 'GRO CHOS SRUNG BKA' NYAN GSUNG BSTOD YIN PAS SKYABS GSUM KUN 'DUS KYI NGO BO YIN TSUL GSUNGS KYANG, BDAG GI RJE BLA MA'I BZHED PA ZIN BRIS SU GSAL BA LTAR SKYABS GSUM 'DUS TSUL DANG, DE LA BRTEN NAS SKYABS YUL BSDU TSUL BCAS GSUNGS PA YANG SHIN TU LEGS SHING KHUNGS DANG LDAN PA YIN NO,,
rows.wylie: mkha' 'gro chos srung bka' nyan gsung bstod yin pas skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin tshul gsungs kyang, bdag gi rje bla ma'i bzhed pa zin bris su gsal ba ltar skyabs gsum 'dus tshul dang, de la brten nas skyabs yul bsdu tshul bcas gsungs pa yang shin tu legs shing khungs dang ldan pa yin no
rows.english: Since in the ritual we sing the praises of skydancers, dharma protectors, and other protector angels, some have said that the Lama is the all-encompassing three places of refuge because He or She embodies these three protector deities.  But the position of my own Holy Lama is the one which is elucidated in the Notes: He explains how this one Being embodies the three actual refuges; therefore the way to dissolve the refuge objects is by relying on this one Being. This is a very good explanation, and it also comes from an authoritative source. _______________

rows.english: There is also the lineage through which the book of instructions on the deep path of the Six Practices of Naropa--along with the profound teachings of personal experience based on the text composed by Lobsang Tenpa Dargye of the Naktsang College of Ganden, and the private instructions on the practices of the body known as the six topics of Naropa--has been imparted so well: 1) The Keeper of the Diamond from Naktsang, Tenpa Dargye 2) Lobsang Tsultrim Tenpay Gyeltsen, our Refuge and Protector, from the New House of Trehor College (aka Drupkangpa, 1848-?) 3) The Good and Glorious Ngawang Lobsang of Takpu, Keeper of the Diamond, from Nakshu College; the Good and Glorious Jampel Tenpay Ngudrup 4) And from his holy lips, granted joyfully to myself.]

rows.acip: H'Um LAS 'OD ZER 'PHROS PAS RDO RJE 'CHANG NAS BZUNG STE, BLA MA BRGYUD PA RNAMS DANG, YI DAM GYI LHA TSOGS RNAMS SPYAN DRANGS TE BSTIMS LA, SDOM 'BYUNG LAS, BLA MA SANGS RGYAS BLA MA CHOS, ,DE BZHIN BLA MA DGE 'DUN NYID, ,CES GSUNGS PA LTAR, SKYABS GSUM KUN 'DUS KYI NGO BOR BSGOM,
rows.wylie: hUM las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste, bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang, yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs te bstims la, sdom 'byung las, bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos, ,de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun nyid, ,ces gsungs pa ltar, skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsgom
rows.english: Light flies out from the hung and calls upon the Lamas of the lineage, beginning with the Keeper of the Diamond, along with the entire assembly of Close Angels.  Then they come and melt into you.  Remember the Source of Vows, where it says: Your Lama is the one and only Buddha, and Dharma, And just so only Sangha. Picture then your Lama as someone who incorporates all three of the sources of protection.

rows.acip: DE LA DANG PO RTZA LAM SBYANG BA NI, SKYABS YUL GSAL GDAB, PHYI NANG GSANG MCHOD KYIS MCHOD, GSOL BA GDAB PA SOGS DANG, SRUNG 'KHOR,
rows.wylie: de la dang po rtsa lam sbyang ba ni, skyabs yul gsal gdab, phyi nang gsang mchod kyis mchod, gsol ba gdab pa sogs dang, srung 'khor
rows.english: Here first is how to clean the paths of the channels.  Begin with visualizing the places where you go for refuge, and then make the three kinds of offering: outer, inner, and secret.  Recite the request for blessing, and then visualize the circles of protection.

rows.acip: DE NAS RGYUD DAG PAR BYA BA'I SLAD DU KHYED RANG RNAMS MDUN GYI NAM MKHAR BLA MA YI DAM CHOS SRUNG DANG BCAS PA LA SANGS RGYAS BYANG SEMS SOGS SKYABS YUL RNAMS KYIS BSKOR NAS BZHUGS PA'I SPYAN SNGAR

rows.english: And then the Diamond Master says, First your hearts must be made pure, So now see here in the air before you Your Lama and Close Angel, Along with the Protectors of the Dharma, Surrounded by those in whom We take our refuge; Say now, in Their presence--

rows.acip: DE YANG KYE MA SEMS CAN 'DI KUN NI, 'KHOR BA LAS THAR PA'I THABS DAM PA 'DI LTA BU SKAD CIG KYANG MI SGOM PAR, SDUG BSNGAL MI BZAD PA CAN GYI 'KHOR BA BSKYABS MED PA 'DIR, SKYE RGAN 'CHI LA SOGS PA'I 'JIGS PAS 'KHRUGS SHING, GA-YO BA DANG LDAN PA 'DI LA SNYING RJE DRAG TU SKYE'O,,
rows.wylie: de yang kye ma sems can 'di kun ni, 'khor ba las thar pa'i thabs dam pa 'di lta bu skad cig kyang mi sgom par, sdug bsngal mi bzad pa can gyi 'khor ba bskyabs med pa 'dir, skye rgan 'chi la sogs pa'i 'jigs pas 'khrugs shing, ga-yo ba dang ldan pa 'di la snying rje drag tu skye'o
rows.english: They see how, oh, all these living creatures, each one their own Mother, have not even a moment's desire to follow a high practice such as this, a way that would free them from the cycle of pain.  The yogi sees how they remain instead here in the round of pain, with all its unbearable misery, and with no one who can protect them from this suffering.  They see how all these people are driven here and there by the terrors of birth, and getting old, and dying, and all the rest.  And so the yogi is overcome by intense feelings of compassion, for every creature on this planet.

rows.acip: BTZUN MO DRI MED SGRON MAS CHOS KYIS GROGS MDZAD, SKYES MCHOG NAM MKHA'I SNYING POS SPANGS NAS, NYER LNGA LA GNAS BZHI DGA' BA'I 'TSAL DU 'PHEBS, MKHAN PO SANGS RGYAS SKYABS DANG, SLOB DPON YE SHES 'OD LA DGE TSUL GYI SDOM PA BZHES NA, MTSAN SANGS RGYAS YES SU GSOL CING LO GSUM BZHUGS,'DUL BA LUNG BZHI, RGYA CHE ROL PA, LAS RGYA PA, DRAN PA NYER BZHAG, SKYE RABS, MDO RTZA RNAMS GSAN CING THUGS SU CHUD PAR MDZAD,
rows.wylie: btsun mo dri med sgron mas chos kyis grogs mdzad, skyes mchog nam mkha'i snying pos spangs nas, nyer lnga la gnas bzhi dga' ba'i 'tshal du 'phebs, mkhan po sangs rgyas skyabs dang, slob dpon ye shes 'od la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes na, mtshan sangs rgyas yes su gsol cing lo gsum bzhugs,'dul ba lung bzhi, rgya che rol pa, las rgya pa, dran pa nyer bzhag, skye rabs, mdo rtsa rnams gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad
rows.english: And so--with Queen Immaculate continually serving as his spiritual companion--our highest of beings, Heart of the Sky, quits the palace.  Now twenty-five years old, He journeys to a place called Pleasure Gardens of the God of the Four Places.  Here He takes His vows as a novice monk, with the monk named Protecting Buddha serving as His vowmaster, and Light of Wisdom acting as the presiding member of the community.  He is granted the name Wisdom of the Buddhas, and remains here for the next three years. * * * Those who are familiar with Master Naropa's story know that He went through terrible hardships to find His own Heart Teacher, Tilopa; and was then subjected to severe tests by this Lama.  Here from Hlatsun Rinchen Namgyal's biography (ff. 44b-45a) is the story of how Naropa was first granted the instructions on the "Ecstasy of the Lower Gates," a reference to the union of the sexual organs of the two partners; a practice which this text calls the highest secret teaching of all.

rows.acip: DANG PO NI, RANG NYID 'KHOR BA DANG NGAN SONG GI 'JIGS PA LAS SKYOB PA'I PHYIR DU DKON MCHOG GSUM LA (SKYABS) SU ('GRO) BA DANG, MA SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYI DON DU SANGS RGYAS KYI GO 'PHANG THOB PAR BYA SNYAM PA'I (SEMS BSKYED) PA DANG,
rows.wylie: dang po ni, rang nyid 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i phyir du dkon mchog gsum la (skyabs) su ('gro) ba dang, ma sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i (sems bskyed) pa dang
rows.english: Here is the first.  To protect myself from the terrors of the cycle of life and the three lower realms, I take shelter in the Three Jewels.  For the sake of every living being, each of them my own Mother, I raise in my heart the Wish for enlightenment: thinking to myself that "I will reach the state of a Buddha, for all of them."

rows.wylie: yang (phyag 'tshal lo,) ,gang la na, 'jigs pa las skyob pas (skyabs) dang, bde bas phan par mdzad pas (mgon) dang, (dam pa) ste mchog tu gyur pa'i bla ma ('i zhabs la)'o
rows.english: I then bow down yet again.  To whom?  I bow at the holy feet of my Lama, who is the refuge that protects me from every fear, and who is as well my Savior, since They do good to me by providing me bliss itself.  This one is highest, in that They are supreme.

rows.acip: DANG PO NI, SKYABS MGON ZHES SOGS RKANG PA GNYIS TE, SNGAR BSHAD PA'I DON GYIS NA (SKYABS MGON) DE LTA BU'I (RJE BTZUN BLA MA 'KHOR) DANG (BCAS) PA RNAMS (LA,) 'OG NAS 'BYUNG BA LTAR PHYI NANG GSANG BA'I MCHOD PA MI 'DRA BA'I KHYAD PAR (SNA TSOGS) PA'I (MCHOD SPRIN RGYA MTSO) STE MANG PO ('BUL BA NI) 'DI LTAR RO,,
rows.wylie: dang po ni, skyabs mgon zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis te, sngar bshad pa'i don gyis na (skyabs mgon) de lta bu'i (rje btsun bla ma 'khor) dang (bcas) pa rnams (la,) 'og nas 'byung ba ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par (sna tshogs) pa'i (mchod sprin rgya mtsho) ste mang po ('bul ba ni) 'di ltar ro
rows.english: The first of these is covered in the four lines that begin with "Here is an ocean of gifts."  Given the points we've just covered, the way we proceed is that we present now an ocean of gifts, a vast cloud (meaning a great number) of every fine thing there is--a variety of different offerings which, as we will see below, include the outer, inner, and secret gifts.  And we present these to our Savior and Protector, as we described Them above: to our holy Lama, and to those within Their circle. The Offering of the Four Waters

rows.wylie: gnyis pa gang la ji ltar 'bul ba ni, (dang ba) ste dad pa('i sems kyis phul du byung) ba'i mchod yul (zhing gi mchog) sngar bshad pa ltar gyi (skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter) mdzod du gyur pa'i bla ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams (la dbul bar bgyi)'o
rows.english: This brings us then to our second point: how we present our offering, and to whom.  I offer all these to that highest karmic object, to the most excellent object of any offering: to my Lama (along with those in His circle), who--as we mentioned before--is a treasure house, a massive storehouse of compassion, my Savior and Protector.  And I do so with thoughts of faith and devotion. The Offering of Our Practice

rows.acip: (BDE) BAR (GSHEGS) PA'I SAR BGROD BYED KYI (LAM BZANG) PO BYANG CHUB KYI SEMS DANG, STONG PA NYID KYI LTA BA SOGS RGYAL BA'I DGONGS PA JI LTA BA (BZHIN) DU MA NOR BAR (STON PA YI) SDUG BSNGAL LAS SKYOB PAS NA (SKYABS) DANG,
rows.wylie: (bde) bar (gshegs) pa'i sar bgrod byed kyi (lam bzang) po byang chub kyi sems dang, stong pa nyid kyi lta ba sogs rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba (bzhin) du ma nor bar (ston pa yi) sdug bsngal las skyob pas na (skyabs) dang
rows.english: Our Lama is our Protector in that They protect us from suffering by teaching us the pure path, teaching it to us without any error at all, just as it really is--meaning, just as it was intended by the victorious Buddhas.  This is the path that we use for travelling to the level of Those Who Have Gone to Bliss: the path of realizations such as the Wish for enlightenment, and the view of emptiness.

rows.acip: DE LTA BU('I NYI MA) DE, (DUS) NGAN KYI DBANG GIS (NUB) PA STE, MYA NGAN LAS 'DAS PA'I TSUL BSTAN PAR ('GYUR TE,) DE'I RJES SU (MGON) DANG (SKYABS MED PA'I) BDAG SOGS SNYIGS MA'I ('GRO BA MANG PO LA) BLANG DOR KYI GNAS STON PA SOGS (RGYAL BA'I MDZAD PA) 'PHRIN LAS NYE BAR (SGRUB BAR MDZAD PA'I SKYABS MGON THUGS) RJE (CAN LA) ZHES PA'O,,
rows.wylie: de lta bu('i nyi ma) de, (dus) ngan kyi dbang gis (nub) pa ste, mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan par ('gyur te,) de'i rjes su (mgon) dang (skyabs med pa'i) bdag sogs snyigs ma'i ('gro ba mang po la) blang dor kyi gnas ston pa sogs (rgyal ba'i mdzad pa) 'phrin las nye bar (sgrub bar mdzad pa'i skyabs mgon thugs) rje (can la) zhes pa'o
rows.english: Due to the fact that these are degenerate times, the sun that this Teacher represents has sunk below the horizon--which is to say, Lord Buddha has pretended to pass into His final enlightenment.  And now here in the days of darkness which have followed Him, there are many living creatures--both myself and others--who have no one to turn to, no one who can protect them.  And so I make this supplication to my Shelter and Savior of compassion, to the One who comes and takes up the enlightened deeds of the Buddhas--deeds such as teaching all of us what it is we should take up, and what give up.

rows.acip: DUS (DENG STE DA) LTA (NAS BZUNG STE BYANG CHUB) CHEN PO MA THOB KYI (BAR DU) SKYID SDUG CI BYUNG YANG (KHYOD MA) YIN PA'I RE SA'I (SKYABS) GNAS (GZHAN) NI YE (MI 'TSOL BAS,)
rows.wylie: dus (deng ste da) lta (nas bzung ste byang chub) chen po ma thob kyi (bar du) skyid sdug ci byung yang (khyod ma) yin pa'i re sa'i (skyabs) gnas (gzhan) ni ye (mi 'tshol bas,)
rows.english: And I seek shelter in no other source of protection at all--I put my hopes in no one other than You--no matter what comes to me, happiness or suffering, from this present moment on to the day that I reach my final, great enlightenment.

rows.acip: DE LA SKYOB PA'I NUS MTHU RDZOGS PAR YOD PA NI DKON MCHOG GSUM KHO NA YIN PAS, DES NA TSIG TZAM MA YIN PAR (SNYING) THAG PA (NAS DKON MCHOG GSUM LA SKYABS SU 'GRO ZHING,)
rows.wylie: de la skyob pa'i nus mthu rdzogs par yod pa ni dkon mchog gsum kho na yin pas, des na tshig tsam ma yin par (snying) thag pa (nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing,)
rows.english: A complete power and ability to protect us from this fate is possessed only by the Three Jewels; and so we take heartfelt--deeply sincere, and not simply in words--refuge in the Three both rare and supreme.

rows.acip: ,SKYABS MGON RJE BTZUN BLA MA 'KHOR BCAS LA, ,SNA TSOGS MCHOD SPRIN RGYA MTSO 'BUL BA NI, ,BKOD LEGS RIN CHEN 'OD 'BAR SNOD YANGS LAS, ,DAG BYED BDUD RTZI'I CHU BZHI DAL GYIS 'BAB,
rows.wylie: skyabs mgon rje btsun bla ma 'khor bcas la, ,sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul ba ni, ,bkod legs rin chen 'od 'bar snod yangs las, ,dag byed bdud rtsi'i chu bzhi dal gyis 'bab
rows.english: Here is an ocean of gifts, A vast cloud of every fine thing there is, Which I present now to my Savior and Protector, My holy Lama, and to those within Their circle. Here is a broad vase of sparkling jewels Arranged in perfect symmetry, And from it softly falls the nectar Of the four waters of deathlessness, To make the world pure.

rows.english: I make supplication to the Compassionate One, To my Protector, my Savior-- To the one who teaches the pure path, The path of Those Gone to Bliss, Just as it really is-- And who teaches it to beings like us, Beings gone wrong in the days of dark, Beings who could not be tamed By countless Buddhas who have come before.

rows.english: The time has come for the sun Of the teachings of the Able One To sink below the horizon; And there are many living creatures Who have no one to turn to, No one who can protect them. And so I make this supplication To my compassionate Shelter and Savior, To the one who takes up The deeds of the Buddhas.

rows.english: You are my Lama You are my Close Angel You are my Angel of the Sky You are my Dharma Protector; I seek no other shelter at all From this moment on to the day That I reach my final enlightenment; Reach out, snare me with the hook Of Your heart's compassion, However far away I am, In this life or the next, Or in the time between. Save me from the terror Of this suffering life; Save me from the terror Of a lower peace; Grant me all attainments, Stay forever at my side, Protect me from every obstacle.

rows.acip: GNOD SEMS KYI NI, YAMS DANG GNOD PA DANG NAD 'GO BA DANG 'KHRUG PA DANG PHA ROL GYI DMAG TSOGS LAS 'KHRUG LONG MANG BA DANG SENG GE DANG STAG LA SOGS PA DANG SBRUL GDUG DANG SDIG PA DANG SRIN GYI ME MANG BA DANG GNOD SBYIN GDUG PA DANG CHOM RKUN LA SOGS PA MANG BA DANG ,
rows.wylie: gnod sems kyi ni, yams dang gnod pa dang nad 'go ba dang 'khrug pa dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs las 'khrug long mang ba dang seng ge dang stag la sogs pa dang sbrul gdug dang sdig pa dang srin gyi me mang ba dang gnod sbyin gdug pa dang chom rkun la sogs pa mang ba dang
rows.english: Because you have wished bad things on others, you live in a world of chaos, where diseases spread, and evil is everywhere, and plague, and conflict, and fear from the armies of other nations; where there are many lions or leopards or other dangerous animals; where there are everywhere venomous snakes or scorpions or poison biting worms; you live surrounded by harmful spirits, and thieves or muggers, and the like.

rows.english: Name any kind of ritual work there is: say you want to lengthen your life, or get rich; to put an end to some bodily illness, headaches or contagions, fevers or anything else; to stop some mental suffering; to make frost, and hail, and famines, and everything of the sort go away; to cause rain to fall, or commit termination, or the like; to clear away harm caused by any of the eight groups of evil, related to the planets, or to the serpentines, to the government of the land or the rest; to accomplish any of the acts that bring you power, bringing in worldly wealth and such; killing or frightening away or splitting or confusing, anything.  There are a countless myriad of such deeds, and the highest method for accomplishing whichever you may wish to do is to make strong effort in the secret words found right here.

rows.acip: ,BZHI PA NI, DMYAL BAR SKYES NAS DMYAL SRUNGS RNAMS MTHONG BA'I TSE KYI HUD SKYES BU SU ZHIG GIS 'JIGS PA CHEN PO 'DI LAS BDAG LEGS PAR SKYOB PAR BYED PAR 'GYUR ZHES SHIN TU SKRAG CING BRED SHA 'THON PA'I MIG BGRAD NAS PHYOGS BZHIR SKYABS DAG TSOL BAR BYED LA DE LTAR BTZAL YANG PHYOGS BZHIR SKYABS MED PAR MTHONG NAS NI DE NAS KUN TU YI MUG 'GYUR BAS DA LTA NYID NAS DKON MCHOG GSUM LA SKYABS SU 'GRO BAR BYA'O, , DES NA DMYAL BA'I GNAS DER 'JIGS PA LAS SKYOB PA'I SKYABS YOD PA MA YIN NA DUS DE'I TSE BDAG GIS JI LTAR BYA THABS CI YANG MED PAS DA LTA NYID NAS 'JIGS PA DANG BRAL BA'I RGYU LA 'BAD PAR BYA'O,
rows.wylie: bzhi pa ni, dmyal bar skyes nas dmyal srungs rnams mthong ba'i tshe kyi hud skyes bu su zhig gis 'jigs pa chen po 'di las bdag legs par skyob par byed par 'gyur zhes shin tu skrag cing bred sha 'thon pa'i mig bgrad nas phyogs bzhir skyabs dag tshol bar byed la de ltar btsal yang phyogs bzhir skyabs med par mthong nas ni de nas kun tu yi mug 'gyur bas da lta nyid nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o, , des na dmyal ba'i gnas der 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i skyabs yod pa ma yin na dus de'i tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya thabs ci yang med pas da lta nyid nas 'jigs pa dang bral ba'i rgyu la 'bad par bya'o
rows.english: Here now is the fourth part: the description of how, in your future life, you will be tormented by pain. And once you have taken your birth in the hells, and you see the hellguards coming for you, then will you be overcome with fear, and scream out, "Ah! Where is there now anyone who can save me completely from this horror?" Your face takes on a look of terror, your eyes open wide with panic, and you turn in every direction to look for someone who can help. You can look, but then you realize that there is no one to protect you, no one in any direction at all, and then the darkness comes and envelops you. Thus it is that you must, from this very moment, take refuge in the Three Jewels. Once you are in this place, in the hells, there is no one at all who can protect you from the terrors of the hells, there is at that moment absolutely nothing that you can do for yourself. And so you should, right now, make efforts in those practices which can save you from the terror later.

rows.acip: ,JI LTAR GSUNGS ZHE NA LAG BZANG GIS ZHUS PA LAS, GZHAN YANG BYANG CHUB SEMS DPA' 'DI LTAR YANG DAG PAR RJES SU SLOB STE GANG DAG SENG GE DANG , STAG DANG , KHYI DANG , CE SPYANG DANG , BYA RGOD DANG KHRUNG KHRUNG DANG BYA ROG DANG 'UG PA DANG SRIN BU DANG , SBRANG MA DANG SBRANG BU DANG SHA SBRANG DU GYUR PA DE DAG KYANG BLA NA MED PAR BYANG CHUB TU 'TSANG RGYA BAR 'GYUR NA BDAG MIR GYUR BZHIN DU SROG GI PHYIR YANG BYANG CHUB THOB PA'I BRTZON 'GRUS RTZOM PAR BYED SNYAM MO, , ZHES PA DANG , DKON MCHOG SPRIN LAS KYANG GSUNGS SO,
rows.wylie: ji ltar gsungs zhe na lag bzang gis zhus pa las, gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar yang dag par rjes su slob ste gang dag seng ge dang , stag dang , khyi dang , ce spyang dang , bya rgod dang khrung khrung dang bya rog dang 'ug pa dang srin bu dang , sbrang ma dang sbrang bu dang sha sbrang du gyur pa de dag kyang bla na med par byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur na bdag mir gyur bzhin du srog gi phyir yang byang chub thob pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom par byed snyam mo, , zhes pa dang , dkon mchog sprin las kyang gsungs so
rows.english: And what are the words which they spoke? They come from the Sutra Requested by Subahu-- Bodhisattvas must, moreover, master the following way of thinking: "Even those beings who are lions, or tigers, or dogs, or wolves, or vultures, or cranes, or crows, or owls, or worms, or flies, or bees, or gnats can bring about the matchless state of enlightenment. And here am I, someone who is living the life of a human--now, no matter what, even if it costs me my life, I will put forth whatever effort is needed to reach enlightenment. This same point is made in the sutra known as The Cloud of the Jewels as well.

rows.english: In future days, when I reach total enlightenment—when I reach my own matchless, perfect, and complete Buddhahood—there will be certain beings who have no one to help them.  Their bodies will be threatened by fires; or they will be thrown in among wild beasts like lions, or tigers; brown bears, snow bears, or poisonous snakes.  Their lives will be in danger; they will feel terrified…no one will be there to protect them, they will cry out, over and over.

rows.english: All the way up until they reach their own final enlightenment, may the fires that threaten their bodies be extinguished.  May the wild beasts they meet—the lions, the tigers, brown bears, snow bears, and poisonous snakes—hold feelings of affection for them.  May they live free of every fear, and may they always live in places full of peace. Good Name's seventh prayer, to stop conflict

rows.acip: 'DI DAG LAS, SA CHU SHING ME RLUNG RNAMS DBANG PO GCIG LDAN DANG, DUNG BUNG BA NYA PHYIS RNAMS DBANG PO NYIS {%GNYIS} LDAN, GROG MA DANG SRIN GYI ME SOGS DBANG PO GSUM LDAN, BUNG BA SBRANG BU MCHU RING SOGS DBANG PO BZHI LDAN, MI DANG RKANG BZHI BA {%PA} BYA SOGS DBANG PO LNGA LDAN DU SONG NGO {%DU 'DOD DO},,
rows.wylie: 'di dag las, sa chu shing me rlung rnams dbang po gcig ldan dang, dung bung ba nya phyis rnams dbang po nyis {%gnyis} ldan, grog ma dang srin gyi me sogs dbang po gsum ldan, bung ba sbrang bu mchu ring sogs dbang po bzhi ldan, mi dang rkang bzhi ba {%pa} bya sogs dbang po lnga ldan du song ngo {%du 'dod do}
rows.english: They say that, from among these, earth, water, plants, fire, and wind only possess a single sense power; conches, worms, and oysters have two; creatures like ants and fireflies have three; those like bees, flies, and mosquitos have four senses; while humans, birds, and four-legged animals possess five sense powers.
